  "notice.policy.purpose.title": "Your local checks",
  "notice.policy.purpose.body": "Surfare checks messages, links, images and QR codes for warning signs. Local checks, image text reading and QR decoding run on your device. Results help you decide what to check next; they can sometimes miss details or misunderstand a message.",
  "notice.policy.sharing.title": "Checking links on your device",
  "notice.policy.sharing.body": "Link checks use local patterns and reference lists. When you press Check while connected, recognized shortened links in messages, web addresses, image text and QR codes are followed automatically through our server. Only each address goes to the linked sites and their HTTP redirect destinations; those sites may record the visit. Web addresses entered in the Links detector are followed when you press Check; other QR links have a separate destination-check button. No message or QR image is sent to these sites. Recognized private QR data and links containing credentials or access tokens are not followed. URL reputation services are not used. AI help has a separate sharing choice.",
  "notice.policy.ai.title": "Choosing online help",
  "notice.policy.ai.body": "AI help is optional and starts off. Turning it on lets the text you check (including text read from an image or QR code), result details, questions, language and up to eight recent chat messages go through Surfare's server. AI double-checks use OpenRouter and its selected model provider first, with Google Gemini as backup. Ask Surfy chat also uses OpenRouter first, with Google Gemini as backup. Online image detection is a separate choice: a smaller JPEG goes to Sightengine, without the original file or its metadata. Surfy receives text, not image bytes. Each provider has its own storage and data-use policy. With AI help off, Surfy uses local replies. Surfy Lifeguard has a separate AI double-check choice: your question, service name, country, selected situations and up to six recent chat messages go through our server to OpenRouter and its selected model provider, with Google Gemini as backup. It starts off, uses existing AI knowledge and does not browse the web. Local guidance works without it.",
  "notice.policy.retention.title": "What stays on your device",
  "notice.policy.retention.body": "Surfare does not save a history of your checks or chat. These stay in the current page session and clear when you reload or close it. Your language, privacy acknowledgment, offline app files and downloaded reports may stay on this device. Up to three items shared from another app can wait locally until opened. Unopened items expire after 10 minutes and are removed when accessed or on a later share. Feedback goes through EmailJS to the team, with the fields you enter, page address and send time; their own retention policies apply. Submissions and feedback are not automatically used for training.",
  "notice.policy.security.title": "A few simple precautions",
  "notice.policy.security.body": "Share only content you have permission to use. Leave out passwords, one-time codes and private access links. Surfare uses request checks and other safeguards to help protect information, though no app can promise perfect security.",
  "notice.policy.rights.title": "Your privacy rights",
  "notice.policy.rights.body": "Your rights under RA 10173, the Data Privacy Act, still apply. Where applicable, these include being informed, access, correction, objection, erasure or blocking, portability, damages, and raising a complaint with the National Privacy Commission, subject to the law. You can review or clear this acknowledgment anytime. Clearing it does not remove information already sent to another service; contact that service about its records. The official links below explain your rights.",
  "notice.policy.terms.title": "Using Surfare",
  "notice.policy.terms.body": "Use Surfare for content you are allowed to check. Results are a guide: a warning is not proof of wrongdoing, and low risk is not a guarantee. local.result.loginQr.title: Login QR code
local.result.loginQr.summary: This looks like a device-linking code, not a website address. That alone is not a scam warning. Surfare cannot confirm who issued it. The code stays on your device.
local.result.loginQr.next: Use it only in the official app for a login you started on your own device.
local.check.progress.wait: Your final result will appear here when the review is done.
local.check.progress.local: Surfy is checking what you shared.
local.result.backgroundReview: Your local result is ready below. AI is still reviewing and may change it. This page updates automatically.
local.check.progress.caution: The first check found a serious warning. Pause before you act.
local.check.highlightHint: Tap highlighted words to see why they stood out.
local.check.nextSafety: Save the message and tell someone you trust. If you feel in immediate danger, seek help now.
local.result.noLocalWarning: The local checks found no recognised scam or threat patterns in this message. This does not verify the sender or establish that the message is safe.
local.result.ocrUncertain: Some words were hard to read. Compare the extracted text with the image and correct any mistakes before checking again.
local.result.reviewText: Edit extracted text and check again
local.result.qrUnsupported: This code contains structured data. Confirm its recipient or details in the app that issued it.
local.result.conflictingReviews: The AI read the wording differently. The stronger warning remains because the check found evidence that still needs verification.
local.result.offlineNotice: You are offline. This result uses local checks only; AI help is available when you reconnect.
local.ask.why.reviewedLow: The AI reviewed what the message asks you to do and found no clear sign of a scam. The sender’s identity is still unverified.
local.signalHelp.personalSafety: If this was sent to you, save the message and tell someone you trust. If you feel in immediate danger, seek help now.
local.signal.pressure: The wording pushes you to act quickly.
local.signal.userinfo: The real destination comes after the @ in this address.
local.signal.shortener: This shortened link hides its final destination.
local.signal.redirect: This link includes an address on another site.
local.signal.new-number: Someone using a new number is asking for a payment.
local.signal.marketplace-payment-link: A buyer directs payment through a link that hides its destination.
local.signal.parcel-fee-link: A parcel fee is requested through an unfamiliar payment website.
local.signal.task-income-recruitment: A hiring offer promises daily pay for simple tasks through a messaging-app recruiter.
local.signal.phishing-test-link: This is Google's published phishing test page, recognised locally.
local.signalHelp.phishingTest: This exact test page is included locally to demonstrate a phishing warning. No live Safe Browsing check was made.
local.signal.delivery: The sender asks you to act to resolve a delivery problem.
local.signal.reward-action: The offer asks you to do something to claim a prize.
local.signal.reward-pressure: The offer sets a short deadline to claim a reward.
local.signal.reward-information: The offer asks for details to claim a prize.
local.signal.download: This link points to a file that can run software.
local.signal.account-bait: A promise of money comes with someone else’s login details.
local.result.tooLong: This check accepts up to 12,000 characters. Check the content in smaller parts.
local.offline.title: Optional offline image text pack
local.offline.body: Text and link checks work offline without this pack. Download 19.3 MB for image text recognition in English and Filipino. The pack downloads only when you choose Download or first use image text recognition.
local.offline.readyBody: English and Filipino image text tools are saved on this device. Online AI image checks still need internet.
local.offline.savedBody: The pack is saved on this device. Full offline use is available in the installed Surfare app.
local.offline.unsupportedBody: This browser cannot save offline files here. Open Surfare in a supported browser over a secure connection.
local.offline.storageError: There is not enough storage to finish. Free up some space, then continue the download.
local.offline.downloadError: The download did not finish. Check your connection and try again. Completed files are kept.
local.offline.caching: Saving resources for offline use in the background
local.tour.offline.title: Check even when offline.
local.tour.offline.body: Download resources here for local checks when you are offline.
local.ask.welcome: Need a second look? Ask about warning signs or your next step.
local.ask.noResult: Run a check first, and I can help explain the warning signs and what to do next.
local.shortcuts.label: Quick shortcuts
local.camera.reviewHelp: Can you read the small text? Retake the photo if it looks soft or hard to read.
local.camera.tips: Use good light, hold steady, and keep text inside the frame.
local.camera.quality.starting: Starting the camera. Keep the text or QR code inside the frame.
local.camera.quality.ready: Detail looks good. Check that small text is sharp before taking the photo.
local.camera.quality.dark: More light will help. Move to a brighter spot and avoid casting a shadow on the text.
local.camera.quality.glare: The image looks washed out. Tilt the camera slightly or reduce glare from a screen or lamp.
local.camera.quality.moving: Hold steady for a moment. Rest your hands or the phone on a stable surface.
local.camera.quality.soft: The image looks soft. Clean the lens, move a little closer, and wait for the camera to focus.
local.camera.quality.detail: Bring the text closer and keep it flat. Small text should fill more of the frame.
local.camera.quality.qrReady: QR code found. Check the decoded text below before using it.
local.tour.invite.title: A quick look around?
local.tour.invite.body: Let Surfy show you how to check something suspicious. You can skip anytime or replay the tour later.
local.intro.eyebrow: A LITTLE CLARITY BEFORE YOU CLICK.
local.intro.tagline: Safer surfing starts with a second look.
local.tour.label: Surfare guided tour
local.tour.welcome.title: Welcome to Surfare.
local.tour.settings.title: Choose your language.
local.tour.settings.body: Switch between English, Filipino, or Taglish here. Choose the language you?re most comfortable with.
local.tour.detectors.title: Four ways to take a closer look.
local.tour.detectors.body: Choose a message, link, image, or QR code. Nothing is scanned until you choose to check.
local.tour.input.title: Bring what feels off.
local.tour.input.body: Paste your message or link, or upload an image or QR code. Then press Check for a closer look.
local.tour.result.title: Clarity, when you need it.
local.tour.result.body: After a check, your result appears here with warning signs and practical next steps. No result is a guarantee of safety.
local.tour.practice.title: Practice with Surfy.
local.tour.practice.body: Play six short missions about Philippine scams. Pick a safer action, learn why it matters, and build your scam radar. The game works offline and saves your best scores on this device.
local.tour.privacy.title: Your content stays yours.
local.tour.privacy.body: Checks run on your device by default. Open this section for details. Tap anything to start exploring, or replay this tour from the footer.
local.nav.connectedBody: Your connection is available. Local checks and optional AI help are ready.
local.nav.disconnectedBody: You can keep checking on this device. Some features need a connection.
local.nav.localCapability: Check messages, links, saved images, and QR codes on your device. Image tools must have downloaded first.

local.notice.policy.purpose.title: Your local checks
local.notice.policy.purpose.body: Surfare checks messages, links, images and QR codes for warning signs. Local checks, image text reading and QR decoding run on your device. Results help you decide what to check next; they can sometimes miss details or misunderstand a message.
local.notice.policy.sharing.title: Checking links on your device
local.notice.policy.sharing.body: Link checks use local patterns and reference lists. When you press Check while connected, recognized shortened links in messages, web addresses, image text and QR codes are followed automatically through our server. Only each address goes to the linked sites and their HTTP redirect destinations; those sites may record the visit. Web addresses entered in the Links detector are followed when you press Check; other QR links have a separate destination-check button. No message or QR image is sent to these sites. Recognized private QR data and links containing credentials or access tokens are not followed. URL reputation services are not used. AI help has a separate sharing choice.
local.notice.policy.ai.title: Choosing online help
local.notice.policy.ai.body: AI help is optional and starts off. Turning it on lets the text you check (including text read from an image or QR code), result details, questions, language and up to eight recent chat messages go through Surfare's server. AI double-checks use OpenRouter and its selected model provider first, with Google Gemini as backup. Ask Surfy chat also uses OpenRouter first, with Google Gemini as backup. Online image detection is a separate choice: a smaller JPEG goes to Sightengine, without the original file or its metadata. Surfy receives text, not image bytes. Each provider has its own storage and data-use policy. With AI help off, Surfy uses local replies. Surfy Lifeguard has a separate AI double-check choice: your question, service name, country, selected situations and up to six recent chat messages go through our server to OpenRouter and its selected model provider, with Google Gemini as backup. It starts off, uses existing AI knowledge and does not browse the web. Local guidance works without it.
local.notice.policy.retention.title: What stays on your device
local.notice.policy.retention.body: Surfare does not save a history of your checks or chat. These stay in the current page session and clear when you reload or close it. Your language, privacy acknowledgment, offline app files and downloaded reports may stay on this device. Up to three items shared from another app can wait locally until opened. Unopened items expire after 10 minutes and are removed when accessed or on a later share. Feedback goes through EmailJS to the team, with the fields you enter, page address and send time; their own retention policies apply. Submissions and feedback are not automatically used for training.
local.notice.policy.security.title: A few simple precautions
local.notice.policy.security.body: Share only content you have permission to use. Leave out passwords, one-time codes and private access links. Surfare uses request checks and other safeguards to help protect information, though no app can promise perfect security.
local.notice.policy.rights.title: Your privacy rights
local.notice.policy.rights.body: Your rights under RA 10173, the Data Privacy Act, still apply. Where applicable, these include being informed, access, correction, objection, erasure or blocking, portability, damages, and raising a complaint with the National Privacy Commission, subject to the law. You can review or clear this acknowledgment anytime. Clearing it does not remove information already sent to another service; contact that service about its records. The official links below explain your rights.
local.notice.policy.terms.title: Using Surfare
local.notice.policy.terms.body: Use Surfare for content you are allowed to check. Results are a guide: a warning is not proof of wrongdoing, and low risk is not a guarantee. Confirm unexpected requests through a contact or app you already know. You can choose Not now and keep browsing; checks and the tour will ask you to review this notice first.

local.signalHelp.codes: Someone who gets your code may be able to sign in or approve a payment. Do not share it.
local.signalHelp.account: Sharing account details or access can let someone take over your account. Use the official app to check.
local.signalHelp.money: You could lose money if you pay before checking the offer. Verify who is asking and what you are paying for.
local.signalHelp.identity: A familiar name is easy to copy. Confirm the sender or full web address through the official app or website.

local.signalHelp.report: This finding is based on a regulator list or notice. Check the official notice and the exact service or web address.

local.ask.imageLimits.answer: Yes. AI checks can miss AI images or flag real photos by mistake. Screenshots and edits can change the result, so check the original source if it matters.
local.ask.imageScore.answer: The score goes from 0 to 1. A higher number means the checker found more signs of AI. It isn't a percentage of how accurate the check is.

local.ask.clickedLink: I already clicked the link. What now?
local.ask.clickedLink.answer:
Close the page and avoid entering anything else.
- If you entered a password or code, secure that account through its official app.
- If something downloaded, update your device?s security software and run a scan.
local.ask.sharedSecret: I shared my code or password. What now?
local.ask.sharedSecret.answer:
Secure the account through its official app or website now.
- Change an exposed password, and change it anywhere else you reused it.
- Contact official support if you shared a code or see unfamiliar activity. Do not send me the code.
local.ask.sentMoney: I already sent money. What can I do?
local.ask.sentMoney.answer:
Contact your bank or payment provider immediately.
- Explain that you suspect a scam and ask whether the payment can be stopped or reversed. Recovery is not guaranteed.
- Keep the messages and receipts. Do not pay anyone who promises to recover the money for a fee.
local.ask.verifySender: How can I verify the sender?
local.ask.verifySender.answer:
Use a contact you find independently.
- Open the organization?s usual app or call a number you already trust.
- Ask whether they sent the request. Names, logos, and profile photos alone do not prove identity.
local.ask.reportSender: Should I block or report the sender?
local.ask.reportSender.answer:
If you suspect a scam, stop replying.
- Save the conversation if you need a record, then use the app?s report or block option.
- If money or account access is involved, contact your provider through official support too.
local.ask.imageScreenshot: Does a screenshot change the result?
local.ask.imageScreenshot.answer:
A screenshot may not keep the original file notes.
- Missing notes do not prove that an image is real or AI-made.
- An online image check can add clues, but it still cannot confirm authenticity.
local.ask.imageVerify: How can I check where this image came from?
local.ask.imageVerify.answer:
Look for the original source before sharing.
- Ask for the original file or search for earlier copies of the image.
- Compare the original date and context. A detector result alone does not verify the story.

local.recovery.label: Surfy Lifeguard
local.recovery.title: Let's take it one step at a time.
local.recovery.launchBody: A little guidance when something feels wrong.
local.recovery.resultAction: Already clicked or sent money? Surfy Lifeguard can guide you
local.recovery.intro: Something didn't feel right? Tell me what happened and we'll make the next steps a little clearer.
local.recovery.planTitle: Here is where you can start.
local.recovery.planIntro: Take the steps that fit your situation. You can ask Surfy if you need a little more help.
local.recovery.multiple: Pick what fits. It is okay if you are not sure.
local.recovery.situation.shared: I shared a password, PIN, OTP, or account details
local.recovery.situation.paid: I sent money or noticed an unauthorized payment
local.recovery.situation.threatened: Someone is threatening or blackmailing me
local.recovery.situation.danger: Someone is in immediate physical danger
local.recovery.situation.unsure: I am not sure what happened
local.recovery.privacy: Your checklist stays on this device. You choose whether to use online AI help.
local.recovery.outside: These hotline numbers are for the Philippines, so they are hidden here. Contact your local emergency services for immediate danger, and use your provider's official app or website for account help.
local.recovery.contactIntro: Use these official channels, not contact details from the suspicious message.
local.recovery.contact.emergency: For immediate danger to someone's physical safety in the Philippines. Do not wait to finish this checklist.
local.recovery.contact.gcash: 2882 is for Globe/TM subscribers. Urgent scam, fraud, and unauthorized-transaction support is available 24/7. Other networks can use the official Help Center's internet-call or chat options.
local.recovery.contact.maya: Maya app support: daily 8 AM to 7 PM, with after-hours assistance for emergencies such as suspected unauthorized transactions.
local.recovery.contact.bank: Contact the bank or payment provider using its official app, your card, or a number you already trust. Report the incident there first. BSP guidance explains escalation if it remains unresolved.
local.recovery.contact.cicc: Philippine cybercrime and online-scam reporting. For payment incidents, contact your bank or e-wallet first; CICC does not replace its fraud support.
local.recovery.step.safety.title: Put physical safety first
local.recovery.step.safety.body: Move to a safer place if you can and contact local emergency services. Reach a trusted person. Do not wait for Surfare or a scam report to resolve immediate danger.
local.recovery.step.payment.title: Report the payment to your provider now
local.recovery.step.payment.body: Ask whether the payment can be stopped or disputed and whether your account needs protection. Keep the case reference number. Recovery is not guaranteed; do not pay a recovery fee to a stranger.
local.recovery.step.account.title: Secure the affected account
local.recovery.step.account.body: Use the official app or website from a device you trust. Change an exposed password, including reused copies, review active sessions, and contact support if you shared an OTP or PIN. Never give Surfare your code.
local.recovery.step.device.title: Check your device
local.recovery.step.device.body: Do not open an unfamiliar download. If you installed something, update your device's security software and run a scan. Avoid banking on a device you suspect is compromised; get trusted technical help if needed.
local.recovery.step.stop.title: Stop interacting with the suspicious page or sender
local.recovery.step.stop.body: Close the page. Do not enter more information, approve requests, or send more money. Opening a link alone does not establish what information, if any, was exposed.
local.recovery.step.review.title: Check what you actually did
local.recovery.step.review.body: Did you type a password, approve a code, make a payment, or install an app? Change your answers if you remember more. Check account activity through the official app, not the suspicious link.
local.recovery.step.evidence.title: Keep a private record
local.recovery.step.evidence.body: Keep the messages, relevant screenshots, receipts, and transaction references for official support. Do not share passwords or OTPs. This downloaded plan does not contain those details.
local.recovery.step.threat.title: Get support for the threat
local.recovery.step.threat.body: Reach a trusted person and report the threat through official cybercrime or police channels. Preserve the messages. If physical danger becomes immediate, use local emergency services.
local.recovery.step.report.title: Report through the relevant official channel
local.recovery.step.report.body: Use your provider's fraud process for account or payment issues and the platform's report tools for abusive accounts. In the Philippines, CICC can receive cybercrime reports. Keep any reference numbers.
local.recovery.limit: A guide to your options, one step at a time. Your provider can confirm what is possible.
local.recovery.rates: Availability can change. Short codes are Philippine numbers; carrier charges may apply. Calls and websites open only when you choose them.

local.ask.helpInfo.title: About the AI double-check
local.ask.helpInfo.what: The AI double-check gives your check a second look and helps Surfy answer your questions. It needs internet and can sometimes miss details.
local.ask.helpInfo.privacy: When it is on, your checked text, result details, questions and recent chat are sent to online AI services. Surfare does not save a check history; those services follow their own data policies.
local.ask.helpInfo.choice: You can turn it off anytime. Image checks have a separate choice.
local.ask.helpInfo.chatWhat: AI chat help lets Surfy explain your image result and answer follow-up questions. It needs internet and does not change the image check.
local.ask.helpInfo.chatPrivacy: Surfy receives written check details, your questions and recent chat, not your photo. Surfare does not save a check history; online services follow their own data policies.
local.recovery.providerHint: e.g. BPI, UnionBank, PayPal or Facebook
local.recovery.providerOptional: A service name is enough. No account numbers, passwords or codes needed.

local.recovery.chat.subtitle: A little help with what comes next.
local.recovery.chat.offline: You are offline. The checklist and local tips still work.

local.recovery.chat.prompt.contact: How do I find the right support?
local.recovery.chat.clarify: Go back to the guide and choose what happened. I'll show you one action to start with.
local.recovery.chat.localContact: Open Help or Support in the app you normally use. For a bank card, use the number printed on the card. The guide also has a “Help me find official support” option.
local.recovery.chat.onlineInfo: Surfy can tailor the next steps to your situation. Uses AI knowledge, without live web browsing.
local.recovery.chat.inviteBody: Ask a question in your own words.

local.qr.payload.unsupported: This QR contains an action we can't check. Only use it if you trust where it came from.

local.qr.reason.redirect_limit: The redirect limit was reached. The complete destination could not be verified.
local.qr.reason.missing_location: The website returned a redirect without a destination address.
local.qr.reason.invalid_redirect: The website returned an invalid redirect address.

local.qr.reason.timeout: The destination did not finish responding in time.
local.qr.reason.network: The destination could not be reached. Existing local warnings still apply.
local.qr.reason.rate_limit: Too many destination checks are running. Wait a moment and try again.

local.qr.reason.invalid_request: The QR destination request was invalid. Scan the code again.
local.qr.reason.origin: This page cannot use the destination service. Refresh and try again.

local.qr.direct: Direct URL; no HTTP redirect observed
local.qr.priorWarning: An earlier check found warning signs; the failed retry does not clear them.
local.qr.simple.ready: This QR contains a website link
local.qr.simple.checked: We found where this link goes

local.qr.simple.confirm: Make sure this is the website you expected. Finding it does not prove it is safe.

local.qr.simple.blocked: Don't open it unless you trust where it came from.
local.qr.simple.sharing: This contacts the linked websites. They may record the visit.
local.qr.simple.earlierWarning: We couldn't recheck it. Earlier warnings still apply.
local.qr.simple.checkedSummary: We found its destination. This does not prove the website is safe.

local.destination.ready: This is the link we found

local.destination.beforeCheck: Checking follows short links online. Websites may record the visit. This link check sends the address, not your full message.
local.qr.reason.hidden_destination: We couldn't reveal the final website. This short link needs a browser or did not provide a redirect.
local.destination.linkBeforeCheck: Checking contacts this website and follows redirects. Websites may record the visit.
local.destination.addressChecked: The redirects were checked; the page content was not.
local.recovery.simple.title: Let's take one step.
local.recovery.simple.intro: You don't have to handle this alone. Let's find your next step.
local.recovery.simple.doneIntro: You can revisit any step or save a copy.
local.recovery.simple.choice.shared: My account or details may be at risk
local.recovery.simple.trustedPerson: If it feels like too much, ask someone you trust to sit with you.
local.recovery.simple.foreignSupport: Open Help or Support in your usual app, or use a number from your card or a website you already trust.
local.recovery.simple.completedCount: {done} of {total} actions marked done. Unfinished steps are still in your guide.
local.recovery.simple.local: No details needed to start. This guide works offline.
local.recovery.simple.step.payment: Don't send any more money. Open Help in the app you used to pay. Report the payment and ask if it can be stopped or disputed. Keep the case reference. Recovery isn't guaranteed.
local.recovery.simple.step.account: Use the official app on a device you trust. Change any exposed password and contact support if you shared a PIN or OTP. Never give Surfare your passwords or codes.
local.recovery.simple.step.device: Don't open the download. If you installed it, avoid banking on that device for now. Update and run its security scanner, or ask someone you trust for technical help.
local.recovery.simple.step.stop: Close the page and stop replying. Don't send more money, share codes, or pay someone promising to recover your money.
local.recovery.simple.step.review: Did you send money, share a password or code, or install an app? If you remember something, use “Did something else happen too?” below to update your guide.
local.recovery.simple.step.evidence: Keep the messages, screenshots and payment receipts for official support. Store them privately. Never share passwords or OTPs.
local.recovery.simple.step.threat: Tell someone you trust and preserve the messages. Report the threat through official police or cybercrime channels. If you're in immediate physical danger, get emergency help now.
local.recovery.simple.step.report: For a payment or account issue, start with your provider's fraud support. Report the sender on the platform too. In the Philippines, CICC accepts cybercrime reports. Keep the reference numbers.
local.recovery.simple.step.safety: Move somewhere safer if you can. Contact local emergency services and a trusted person now. You do not need to finish this guide first.

base.notice.policy.purpose.title: Your local checks
base.notice.policy.purpose.body: Surfare checks messages, links, images and QR codes for warning signs. Local checks, image text reading and QR decoding run on your device. Results help you decide what to check next; they can sometimes miss details or misunderstand a message.
base.notice.policy.sharing.title: Checking links on your device
base.notice.policy.sharing.body: Link checks use local patterns and reference lists. When you press Check while connected, recognized shortened links in messages, web addresses, image text and QR codes are followed automatically through our server. Only each address goes to the linked sites and their HTTP redirect destinations; those sites may record the visit. Web addresses entered in the Links detector are followed when you press Check; other QR links have a separate destination-check button. No message or QR image is sent to these sites. Recognized private QR data and links containing credentials or access tokens are not followed. URL reputation services are not used. AI help has a separate sharing choice.
base.notice.policy.ai.title: Choosing online help
base.notice.policy.ai.body: AI help is optional and starts off. Turning it on lets the text you check (including text read from an image or QR code), result details, questions, language and up to eight recent chat messages go through Surfare's server. AI double-checks use OpenRouter and its selected model provider first, with Google Gemini as backup. Ask Surfy chat also uses OpenRouter first, with Google Gemini as backup. Online image detection is a separate choice: a smaller JPEG goes to Sightengine, without the original file or its metadata. Surfy receives text, not image bytes. Each provider has its own storage and data-use policy. With AI help off, Surfy uses local replies. Surfy Lifeguard has a separate AI double-check choice: your question, service name, country, selected situations and up to six recent chat messages go through our server to OpenRouter and its selected model provider, with Google Gemini as backup. It starts off, uses existing AI knowledge and does not browse the web. Local guidance works without it.
base.notice.policy.retention.title: What stays on your device
base.notice.policy.retention.body: Surfare does not save a history of your checks or chat. These stay in the current page session and clear when you reload or close it. Your language, privacy acknowledgment, offline app files and downloaded reports may stay on this device. Up to three items shared from another app can wait locally until opened. Unopened items expire after 10 minutes and are removed when accessed or on a later share. Feedback goes through EmailJS to the team, with the fields you enter, page address and send time; their own retention policies apply. Submissions and feedback are not automatically used for training.
base.notice.policy.security.title: A few simple precautions
base.notice.policy.security.body: Share only content you have permission to use. Leave out passwords, one-time codes and private access links. Surfare uses request checks and other safeguards to help protect information, though no app can promise perfect security.
base.notice.policy.rights.title: Your privacy rights
base.notice.policy.rights.body: Your rights under RA 10173, the Data Privacy Act, still apply. Where applicable, these include being informed, access, correction, objection, erasure or blocking, portability, damages, and raising a complaint with the National Privacy Commission, subject to the law. You can review or clear this acknowledgment anytime. Clearing it does not remove information already sent to another service; contact that service about its records. The official links below explain your rights.
base.notice.policy.terms.title: Using Surfare
base.notice.policy.terms.body: Use Surfare for content you are allowed to check. Results are a guide: a warning is not proof of wrongdoing, and low risk is not a guarantee. Confirm unexpected requests through a contact or app you already know. You can choose Not now and keep browsing; checks and the tour will ask you to review this notice first.

base.ask.imageScore.answer: The score goes from 0 to 1. A higher number means the checker found more signs of AI. It isn't a percentage of how accurate the check is.

base.ask.clickedLink: I already clicked the link. What now?
base.ask.clickedLink.answer:
Close the page and avoid entering anything else.
- If you entered a password or code, secure that account through its official app.
- If something downloaded, update your device?s security software and run a scan.
base.ask.sharedSecret: I shared my code or password. What now?
base.ask.sharedSecret.answer:
Secure the account through its official app or website now.
- Change an exposed password, and change it anywhere else you reused it.
- Contact official support if you shared a code or see unfamiliar activity. Do not send me the code.
base.ask.sentMoney: I already sent money. What can I do?
base.ask.sentMoney.answer:
Contact your bank or payment provider immediately.
- Explain that you suspect a scam and ask whether the payment can be stopped or reversed. Recovery is not guaranteed.
- Keep the messages and receipts. Do not pay anyone who promises to recover the money for a fee.
base.ask.verifySender: How can I verify the sender?
base.ask.verifySender.answer:
Use a contact you find independently.
- Open the organization?s usual app or call a number you already trust.
- Ask whether they sent the request. Names, logos, and profile photos alone do not prove identity.
base.ask.reportSender: Should I block or report the sender?
base.ask.reportSender.answer:
If you suspect a scam, stop replying.
- Save the conversation if you need a record, then use the app?s report or block option.
- If money or account access is involved, contact your provider through official support too.
base.ask.imageScreenshot: Does a screenshot change the result?
base.ask.imageScreenshot.answer:
A screenshot may not keep the original file notes.
- Missing notes do not prove that an image is real or AI-made.
- An online image check can add clues, but it still cannot confirm authenticity.
base.ask.imageVerify: How can I check where this image came from?
base.ask.imageVerify.answer:
Look for the original source before sharing.
- Ask for the original file or search for earlier copies of the image.
- Compare the original date and context. A detector result alone does not verify the story.

base.recovery.label: Surfy Lifeguard
base.recovery.title: Let's take it one step at a time.
base.recovery.launchBody: A little guidance when something feels wrong.
base.recovery.resultAction: Already clicked or sent money? Surfy Lifeguard can guide you
base.recovery.intro: Something didn't feel right? Tell me what happened and we'll make the next steps a little clearer.
base.recovery.planTitle: Here is where you can start.
base.recovery.planIntro: Take the steps that fit your situation. You can ask Surfy if you need a little more help.
base.recovery.multiple: Pick what fits. It is okay if you are not sure.
base.recovery.situation.shared: I shared a password, PIN, OTP, or account details
base.recovery.situation.paid: I sent money or noticed an unauthorized payment
base.recovery.situation.threatened: Someone is threatening or blackmailing me
base.recovery.situation.danger: Someone is in immediate physical danger
base.recovery.situation.unsure: I am not sure what happened
base.recovery.privacy: Your checklist stays on this device. You choose whether to use online AI help.
base.recovery.outside: These hotline numbers are for the Philippines, so they are hidden here. Contact your local emergency services for immediate danger, and use your provider's official app or website for account help.
base.recovery.contactIntro: Use these official channels, not contact details from the suspicious message.
base.recovery.contact.emergency: For immediate danger to someone's physical safety in the Philippines. Do not wait to finish this checklist.
base.recovery.contact.gcash: 2882 is for Globe/TM subscribers. Urgent scam, fraud, and unauthorized-transaction support is available 24/7. Other networks can use the official Help Center's internet-call or chat options.
base.recovery.contact.maya: Maya app support: daily 8 AM to 7 PM, with after-hours assistance for emergencies such as suspected unauthorized transactions.
base.recovery.contact.bank: Contact the bank or payment provider using its official app, your card, or a number you already trust. Report the incident there first. BSP guidance explains escalation if it remains unresolved.
base.recovery.contact.cicc: Philippine cybercrime and online-scam reporting. For payment incidents, contact your bank or e-wallet first; CICC does not replace its fraud support.
base.recovery.step.safety.title: Put physical safety first
base.recovery.step.safety.body: Move to a safer place if you can and contact local emergency services. Reach a trusted person. Do not wait for Surfare or a scam report to resolve immediate danger.
base.recovery.step.payment.title: Report the payment to your provider now
base.recovery.step.payment.body: Ask whether the payment can be stopped or disputed and whether your account needs protection. Keep the case reference number. Recovery is not guaranteed; do not pay a recovery fee to a stranger.
base.recovery.step.account.title: Secure the affected account
base.recovery.step.account.body: Use the official app or website from a device you trust. Change an exposed password, including reused copies, review active sessions, and contact support if you shared an OTP or PIN. Never give Surfare your code.
base.recovery.step.device.title: Check your device
base.recovery.step.device.body: Do not open an unfamiliar download. If you installed something, update your device's security software and run a scan. Avoid banking on a device you suspect is compromised; get trusted technical help if needed.
base.recovery.step.stop.title: Stop interacting with the suspicious page or sender
base.recovery.step.stop.body: Close the page. Do not enter more information, approve requests, or send more money. Opening a link alone does not establish what information, if any, was exposed.
base.recovery.step.review.title: Check what you actually did
base.recovery.step.review.body: Did you type a password, approve a code, make a payment, or install an app? Change your answers if you remember more. Check account activity through the official app, not the suspicious link.
base.recovery.step.evidence.title: Keep a private record
base.recovery.step.evidence.body: Keep the messages, relevant screenshots, receipts, and transaction references for official support. Do not share passwords or OTPs. This downloaded plan does not contain those details.
base.recovery.step.threat.title: Get support for the threat
base.recovery.step.threat.body: Reach a trusted person and report the threat through official cybercrime or police channels. Preserve the messages. If physical danger becomes immediate, use local emergency services.
base.recovery.step.report.title: Report through the relevant official channel
base.recovery.step.report.body: Use your provider's fraud process for account or payment issues and the platform's report tools for abusive accounts. In the Philippines, CICC can receive cybercrime reports. Keep any reference numbers.
base.recovery.limit: A guide to your options, one step at a time. Your provider can confirm what is possible.
base.recovery.rates: Availability can change. Short codes are Philippine numbers; carrier charges may apply. Calls and websites open only when you choose them.

base.qr.simple.blocked: Don't open it unless you trust where it came from.

incoming.notice.policy.purpose.title: Your local checks
incoming.notice.policy.purpose.body: Surfare checks messages, links, images and QR codes for warning signs. Local checks, image text reading and QR decoding run on your device. Results help you decide what to check next; they can sometimes miss details or misunderstand a message.
incoming.notice.policy.sharing.title: Checking links on your device
incoming.notice.policy.sharing.body: Link checks use local patterns and reference lists. When you press Check while connected, recognized shortened links in messages, web addresses, image text and QR codes are followed automatically through our server. Only each address goes to the linked sites and their HTTP redirect destinations; those sites may record the visit. Web addresses entered in the Links detector are followed when you press Check; other QR links have a separate destination-check button. No message or QR image is sent to these sites. Recognized private QR data and links containing credentials or access tokens are not followed. URL reputation services are not used. AI help has a separate sharing choice.
incoming.notice.policy.ai.title: Choosing online help
incoming.notice.policy.ai.body: AI help is optional and starts off. Turning it on lets the text you check (including text read from an image or QR code), result details, questions, language and up to eight recent chat messages go through Surfare's server. AI double-checks use OpenRouter and its selected model provider first, with Google Gemini as backup. Ask Surfy chat also uses OpenRouter first, with Google Gemini as backup. Online image detection is a separate choice: a smaller JPEG goes to Sightengine, without the original file or its metadata. Surfy receives text, not image bytes. Each provider has its own storage and data-use policy. With AI help off, Surfy uses local replies. Surfy Lifeguard has a separate AI double-check choice: your question, service name, country, selected situations and up to six recent chat messages go through our server to OpenRouter and its selected model provider, with Google Gemini as backup. It starts off, uses existing AI knowledge and does not browse the web. Local guidance works without it.
incoming.notice.policy.retention.title: What stays on your device
incoming.notice.policy.retention.body: Surfare does not save a history of your checks or chat. These stay in the current page session and clear when you reload or close it. Your language, privacy acknowledgment, offline app files and downloaded reports may stay on this device. Up to three items shared from another app can wait locally until opened. Unopened items expire after 10 minutes and are removed when accessed or on a later share. Feedback goes through EmailJS to the team, with the fields you enter, page address and send time; their own retention policies apply. Submissions and feedback are not automatically used for training.
incoming.notice.policy.security.title: A few simple precautions
incoming.notice.policy.security.body: Share only content you have permission to use. Leave out passwords, one-time codes and private access links. Surfare uses request checks and other safeguards to help protect information, though no app can promise perfect security.
incoming.notice.policy.rights.title: Your privacy rights
incoming.notice.policy.rights.body: Your rights under RA 10173, the Data Privacy Act, still apply. Where applicable, these include being informed, access, correction, objection, erasure or blocking, portability, damages, and raising a complaint with the National Privacy Commission, subject to the law. You can review or clear this acknowledgment anytime. Clearing it does not remove information already sent to another service; contact that service about its records. The official links below explain your rights.
incoming.notice.policy.terms.title: Using Surfare
incoming.notice.policy.terms.body: Use Surfare for content you are allowed to check. Results are a guide: a warning is not proof of wrongdoing, and low risk is not a guarantee. Confirm unexpected requests through a contact or app you already know. You can choose Not now and keep browsing; checks and the tour will ask you to review this notice first.

incoming.ask.brief.verify: Verify unexpected requests through an official app or a known contact.

incoming.ask.clickedLink: I already clicked the link. What now?
incoming.ask.clickedLink.answer:
Close the page and avoid entering anything else.
- If you entered a password or code, secure that account through its official app.
- If something downloaded, update your device?s security software and run a scan.
incoming.ask.sharedSecret: I shared my code or password. What now?
incoming.ask.sharedSecret.answer:
Secure the account through its official app or website now.
- Change an exposed password, and change it anywhere else you reused it.
- Contact official support if you shared a code or see unfamiliar activity. Do not send me the code.
incoming.ask.sentMoney: I already sent money. What can I do?
incoming.ask.sentMoney.answer:
Contact your bank or payment provider immediately.
- Explain that you suspect a scam and ask whether the payment can be stopped or reversed. Recovery is not guaranteed.
- Keep the messages and receipts. Do not pay anyone who promises to recover the money for a fee.
incoming.ask.verifySender: How can I verify the sender?
incoming.ask.verifySender.answer:
Use a contact you find independently.
- Open the organization?s usual app or call a number you already trust.
- Ask whether they sent the request. Names, logos, and profile photos alone do not prove identity.
incoming.ask.reportSender: Should I block or report the sender?
incoming.ask.reportSender.answer:
If you suspect a scam, stop replying.
- Save the conversation if you need a record, then use the app?s report or block option.
- If money or account access is involved, contact your provider through official support too.
incoming.ask.imageScreenshot: Does a screenshot change the result?
incoming.ask.imageScreenshot.answer:
A screenshot may not keep the original file notes.
- Missing notes do not prove that an image is real or AI-made.
- An online image check can add clues, but it still cannot confirm authenticity.
incoming.ask.imageVerify: How can I check where this image came from?
incoming.ask.imageVerify.answer:
Look for the original source before sharing.
- Ask for the original file or search for earlier copies of the image.
- Compare the original date and context. A detector result alone does not verify the story.

incoming.recovery.label: Surfy Lifeguard
incoming.recovery.title: Let's take it one step at a time.
incoming.recovery.launchBody: A little guidance when something feels wrong.
incoming.recovery.resultAction: Already clicked or sent money? Surfy Lifeguard can guide you
incoming.recovery.intro: Something didn't feel right? Tell me what happened and we'll make the next steps a little clearer.
incoming.recovery.planTitle: Here is where you can start.
incoming.recovery.planIntro: Take the steps that fit your situation. You can ask Surfy if you need a little more help.
incoming.recovery.multiple: Pick what fits. It is okay if you are not sure.
incoming.recovery.situation.shared: I shared a password, PIN, OTP, or account details
incoming.recovery.situation.paid: I sent money or noticed an unauthorized payment
incoming.recovery.situation.threatened: Someone is threatening or blackmailing me
incoming.recovery.situation.danger: Someone is in immediate physical danger
incoming.recovery.situation.unsure: I am not sure what happened
incoming.recovery.privacy: Your checklist stays on this device. You choose whether to use online AI help.
incoming.recovery.outside: These hotline numbers are for the Philippines, so they are hidden here. Contact your local emergency services for immediate danger, and use your provider's official app or website for account help.
incoming.recovery.contactIntro: Use these official channels, not contact details from the suspicious message.
incoming.recovery.contact.emergency: For immediate danger to someone's physical safety in the Philippines. Do not wait to finish this checklist.
incoming.recovery.contact.gcash: 2882 is for Globe/TM subscribers. Urgent scam, fraud, and unauthorized-transaction support is available 24/7. Other networks can use the official Help Center's internet-call or chat options.
incoming.recovery.contact.maya: Maya app support: daily 8 AM to 7 PM, with after-hours assistance for emergencies such as suspected unauthorized transactions.
incoming.recovery.contact.bank: Contact the bank or payment provider using its official app, your card, or a number you already trust. Report the incident there first. BSP guidance explains escalation if it remains unresolved.
incoming.recovery.contact.cicc: Philippine cybercrime and online-scam reporting. For payment incidents, contact your bank or e-wallet first; CICC does not replace its fraud support.
incoming.recovery.step.safety.title: Put physical safety first
incoming.recovery.step.safety.body: Move to a safer place if you can and contact local emergency services. Reach a trusted person. Do not wait for Surfare or a scam report to resolve immediate danger.
incoming.recovery.step.payment.title: Report the payment to your provider now
incoming.recovery.step.payment.body: Ask whether the payment can be stopped or disputed and whether your account needs protection. Keep the case reference number. Recovery is not guaranteed; do not pay a recovery fee to a stranger.
incoming.recovery.step.account.title: Secure the affected account
incoming.recovery.step.account.body: Use the official app or website from a device you trust. Change an exposed password, including reused copies, review active sessions, and contact support if you shared an OTP or PIN. Never give Surfare your code.
incoming.recovery.step.device.title: Check your device
incoming.recovery.step.device.body: Do not open an unfamiliar download. If you installed something, update your device's security software and run a scan. Avoid banking on a device you suspect is compromised; get trusted technical help if needed.
incoming.recovery.step.stop.title: Stop interacting with the suspicious page or sender
incoming.recovery.step.stop.body: Close the page. Do not enter more information, approve requests, or send more money. Opening a link alone does not establish what information, if any, was exposed.
incoming.recovery.step.review.title: Check what you actually did
incoming.recovery.step.review.body: Did you type a password, approve a code, make a payment, or install an app? Change your answers if you remember more. Check account activity through the official app, not the suspicious link.
incoming.recovery.step.evidence.title: Keep a private record
incoming.recovery.step.evidence.body: Keep the messages, relevant screenshots, receipts, and transaction references for official support. Do not share passwords or OTPs. This downloaded plan does not contain those details.
incoming.recovery.step.threat.title: Get support for the threat
incoming.recovery.step.threat.body: Reach a trusted person and report the threat through official cybercrime or police channels. Preserve the messages. If physical danger becomes immediate, use local emergency services.
incoming.recovery.step.report.title: Report through the relevant official channel
incoming.recovery.step.report.body: Use your provider's fraud process for account or payment issues and the platform's report tools for abusive accounts. In the Philippines, CICC can receive cybercrime reports. Keep any reference numbers.
incoming.recovery.limit: A guide to your options, one step at a time. Your provider can confirm what is possible.
incoming.recovery.rates: Availability can change. Short codes are Philippine numbers; carrier charges may apply. Calls and websites open only when you choose them.
incoming.signal.gift-card-prize-fee: A prize offer asks you to buy a gift card or send its code.
incoming.signal.unsolicited-work-offer: A paid-work selection directs you to an unverified link.
incoming.signal.parcel-update-link: Delivery details are requested through an unfamiliar website.
incoming.signal.account-alert-link: A banking or wallet alert directs you outside the listed official sites.
incoming.notice.singleAcknowledgment: I have read and understand the privacy notice and terms. Optional online help remains my choice.
incoming.notice.scrollToContinue: Scroll to the end, then tick the box below.
incoming.notice.reachedEnd: You have reached the end. You can now tick the box.
incoming.ask.onlineProcessing: Optional online help for the content you choose to check. Open the info button to learn more.
incoming.ask.onlinePrivacy: About the AI double-check and privacy
incoming.ask.helpInfo.title: About the AI double-check
incoming.ask.helpInfo.what: The AI double-check gives your check a second look and helps Surfy answer your questions. It needs internet and can sometimes miss details.
incoming.ask.helpInfo.privacy: When it is on, your checked text, result details, questions and recent chat are sent to online AI services. Surfare does not save a check history; those services follow their own data policies.
incoming.ask.helpInfo.choice: You can turn it off anytime. Image checks have a separate choice.
incoming.ask.helpInfo.chatWhat: AI chat help lets Surfy explain your image result and answer follow-up questions. It needs internet and does not change the image check.
incoming.ask.helpInfo.chatPrivacy: Surfy receives written check details, your questions and recent chat, not your photo. Surfare does not save a check history; online services follow their own data policies.
incoming.recovery.providerHint: e.g. BPI, UnionBank, PayPal or Facebook
incoming.recovery.providerOptional: A service name is enough. No account numbers, passwords or codes needed.
incoming.recovery.chat.title: Ask Surfy
incoming.recovery.chat.subtitle: A little help with what comes next.
incoming.recovery.chat.offline: You are offline. The checklist and local tips still work.
incoming.recovery.chat.greeting: I'm here to help you work out what to do next. Tell me what happened, or pick a question below.
incoming.recovery.chat.unavailable: Surfy's online help is unavailable. Here is a general next step instead:
incoming.recovery.chat.privacy: No passwords or codes needed. This conversation clears when you close Surfy Lifeguard. Online services have their own data policies.
incoming.recovery.chat.prompt.contact: How do I find the right support?
incoming.recovery.chat.clarify: Choose what happened on the checklist so I can suggest a general next step. For more specific questions, add the service name and turn on the AI double-check.
incoming.recovery.chat.localContact: Start with Help or Support inside the app you normally use. For a bank card, use the contact printed on the card. Add the service name and enable the AI double-check for more guidance.
incoming.recovery.chat.onlineInfo: Surfy can tailor the next steps to your situation. Uses AI knowledge, without live web browsing.
incoming.recovery.chat.inviteBody: Ask a question in your own words.
incoming.result.imageMetadata.visualNetwork: The image could not reach the image service. Check your connection and try again. Your local file notes are still available.
incoming.qr.title: About this QR code
incoming.qr.offline: Connect to the internet to check this link.
incoming.qr.privacy: Checking a short link contacts that website and follows its HTTP redirects. Other links are contacted only when you choose to check their destination. Websites may record the visit. No QR image is uploaded.
incoming.qr.summary: Check where this link goes before opening it.
incoming.qr.warningSummary: We found warning signs in this link. Pause before opening it.
incoming.qr.limitation: Each recorded address is checked with local rules and reference lists. This is not a live reputation lookup or proof of safety. JavaScript, HTML refreshes, browser-specific redirects and page content are not checked. AI double-checks do not follow links.
incoming.qr.payload.text: This QR contains text. We checked it for warning signs.
incoming.qr.payload.private: This QR contains private details. They stay on your device, and we cannot verify them here.
incoming.qr.payload.unsupported: This QR contains an action we can't check. Only use it if you trust where it came from.
incoming.qr.reason.blocked_target: This target was not contacted: private networks, embedded credentials or access tokens, non-web protocols and unusual ports are blocked.
incoming.qr.reason.redirect_loop: The link repeats a previous address. The redirect check stopped.
incoming.qr.reason.redirect_limit: The redirect limit was reached. The complete destination could not be verified.
incoming.qr.reason.missing_location: The website returned a redirect without a destination address.
incoming.qr.reason.invalid_redirect: The website returned an invalid redirect address.
incoming.qr.reason.http_error: The website refused the request or returned an error. The destination could not be verified.
incoming.qr.reason.timeout: The destination did not finish responding in time.
incoming.qr.reason.network: The destination could not be reached. Existing local warnings still apply.
incoming.qr.reason.rate_limit: Too many destination checks are running. Wait a moment and try again.
incoming.qr.reason.service_unavailable: Destination checking is unavailable on this server. Local QR checks still work.
incoming.qr.reason.invalid_request: The QR destination request was invalid. Scan the code again.
incoming.qr.reason.origin: This page cannot use the destination service. Refresh and try again.
incoming.qr.reason.method: The destination request could not be processed.
incoming.qr.direct: Direct URL; no HTTP redirect observed
incoming.qr.priorWarning: An earlier check found warning signs; the failed retry does not clear them.
incoming.qr.simple.ready: This QR contains a website link
incoming.qr.simple.checked: We found where this link goes
incoming.qr.simple.before: Check its destination before deciding whether to open it.
incoming.qr.simple.avoid: Avoid opening it. Use the service's usual app or website instead.
incoming.qr.simple.confirm: Make sure this is the website you expected. Finding it does not prove it is safe.
incoming.qr.simple.tryLater: We couldn't confirm where it goes. Check with the sender before opening it.
incoming.qr.simple.blocked: Don't open it unless you trust where it came from.
incoming.qr.simple.sharing: This contacts the linked websites. They may record the visit.
incoming.qr.simple.earlierWarning: We couldn't recheck it. Earlier warnings still apply.
incoming.qr.simple.checkedSummary: We found its destination. This does not prove the website is safe.
incoming.destination.title: Where the link goes
incoming.destination.ready: This is the link we found
incoming.destination.privacy: This destination check sends only the selected address through Surfare to the linked websites. They may record the visit. It does not send your full message.
incoming.destination.checkingBody: We are following the short link and checking the addresses along the way.
incoming.destination.beforeCheck: Checking follows short links online. Websites may record the visit. This link check sends the address, not your full message.
incoming.qr.reason.hidden_destination: We couldn't reveal the final website. This short link needs a browser or did not provide a redirect.
incoming.destination.linkBeforeCheck: Checking contacts this website and follows redirects. Websites may record the visit.
incoming.destination.addressChecked: The redirects were checked; the page content was not.

  "notice.policy.sharing.title": "Pagsusuri ng link sa device",
  "notice.policy.sharing.body": "Lokal na mga panuntunan at listahan ang gamit sa link checks. Kapag pinindot ang Suriin habang konektado, awtomatikong sinusundan sa server namin ang kilalang pinaikling link sa mensahe, web address, teksto sa larawan, at QR. Address lang ang ipinapadala sa mga website at HTTP redirect nito; maaari nilang maitala ang pagbisita. Awtomatikong sinusundan ang address sa Links detector kapag pinindot ang Suriin. May hiwalay na button para sa ibang QR link. Hindi ipinapadala ang mensahe o larawan ng QR sa mga site. Hindi sinusundan ang kinikilalang pribadong QR at mga link na may credential o access token. Walang URL reputation service. Hiwalay ang pagpili sa AI help.",
  "notice.policy.ai.title": "Pagpili sa online help",
  "notice.policy.ai.body": "Opsyonal ang AI help at naka-off sa simula. Kapag ini-on, maaaring dumaan sa server ng Surfare ang sinuring teksto (kasama ang nabasa sa larawan o QR code), detalye ng resulta, tanong, wika at hanggang walong kamakailang chat messages. Ang AI double-check ay papunta sa OpenRouter at napiling model provider nito muna, may Google Gemini bilang backup. OpenRouter din muna ang Ask Surfy chat, may Google Gemini bilang backup. Hiwalay ang online image detection: pinaliit na JPEG ang napupunta sa Sightengine, nang wala ang orihinal na file at metadata nito. Teksto lang ang natatanggap ni Surfy, hindi image bytes. May sariling patakaran sa pag-iimbak at paggamit ng datos ang bawat provider. Lokal ang sagot ni Surfy kapag naka-off ang AI help. Hiwalay ang opsiyon sa AI double-check ng gabay: ang tanong, pangalan ng serbisyo, bansa, piniling sitwasyon at hanggang anim na huling mensahe ay dadaan sa server namin papunta sa OpenRouter at napiling model provider nito, may Google Gemini bilang backup. Naka-off ito sa simula at gumagamit ng kaalaman ng AI, walang paghahanap sa web. Gumagana ang lokal na gabay nang wala ito.",
  "notice.policy.retention.title": "Ano ang nananatili sa device mo",
  "notice.policy.retention.body": "Walang sine-save na kasaysayan ng pagsusuri o chat ang Surfare. Nasa kasalukuyang page session ang mga ito at nawawala kapag ni-reload o isinara ito. Maaaring manatili sa device ang wika, pagkilala sa privacy notice, offline app files at na-download na ulat. Hanggang tatlong shared item ang maaaring maghintay sa device hanggang buksan. Nag-e-expire ang hindi nabuksan pagkalipas ng 10 minuto at inaalis kapag in-access o sa susunod na share. Dumadaan ang feedback sa EmailJS papunta sa team, kasama ang mga field na inilagay mo, page address at oras ng pagpapadala; may sariling retention policies ang mga iyon. Hindi awtomatikong ginagamit sa training ang submissions at feedback.",
  "notice.policy.security.title": "Ilang simpleng pag-iingat",
  "notice.policy.security.body": "Magbahagi lang ng nilalamang may pahintulot kang gamitin. Huwag isama ang password, one-time code at pribadong access link. Gumagamit ang Surfare ng request checks at iba pang pag-iingat upang makatulong na protektahan ang impormasyon, bagamat walang app na makapangangako ng ganap na seguridad.",
  "notice.policy.rights.title": "Mga karapatan mo sa privacy",
  "notice.policy.rights.body": "Nananatili ang mga karapatan mo sa RA 10173, ang Data Privacy Act. Kung naaangkop, kasama rito ang pagiging may kaalaman, access, pagwawasto, pagtutol, pagbura o pag-block, portability, danyos at pagrereklamo sa National Privacy Commission, alinsunod sa batas. Maaari mong balikan o burahin ang pagkilalang ito anumang oras. Hindi nito inaalis ang datos na naipadala na sa ibang serbisyo; makipag-ugnayan sa serbisyong iyon tungkol sa kanilang tala. local.result.loginQr.title: QR code para mag-log in
local.result.loginQr.summary: Mukhang code ito para mag-link ng device, hindi address ng website. Hindi ito sapat na batayan para tawaging scam. Hindi makukumpirma ng Surfare kung sino ang gumawa nito. Mananatili ang code sa iyong device.
local.result.loginQr.next: Gamitin lamang ito sa opisyal na app para sa pag-log in na ikaw mismo ang nagsimula sa sarili mong device.
local.check.progress.wait: Lalabas dito ang huling resulta kapag tapos na ang pagsusuri.
local.check.progress.local: Sinusuri ni Surfy ang ibinahagi mo.
local.result.backgroundReview: Handa na sa ibaba ang lokal na resulta. Sinusuri pa ito ng AI at maaaring magbago. Kusang maa-update ang pahinang ito.
local.check.progress.caution: May nakitang seryosong babala sa unang pagsusuri. Maghintay muna bago kumilos.
local.check.highlightHint: Pindutin ang mga salitang may marka para malaman kung bakit.
local.check.nextSafety: Itabi ang mensahe at magsabi sa taong pinagkakatiwalaan mo. Humingi agad ng tulong kung nasa panganib ka.
local.result.noLocalWarning: Walang nakilalang pattern ng scam o banta sa lokal na pagsusuri. Hindi nito napapatunayan ang sender o ang kaligtasan ng mensahe.
local.result.ocrUncertain: May ilang salitang mahirap basahin. Ihambing ang nabasang teksto sa larawan at itama ang mali bago suriin muli.
local.result.reviewText: I-edit ang nabasang teksto at suriin muli
local.result.qrUnsupported: May nakatalang datos sa code. Tiyakin ang mga detalye o tatanggap sa app na naglabas nito.
local.result.conflictingReviews: Iba ang pagbasa ng AI. Nananatili ang mas mataas na babala dahil may nakitang palatandaang dapat tiyakin.
local.result.offlineNotice: Offline ka. Lokal na pagsusuri lang ang resultang ito; magagamit ang AI help kapag kumonekta ka muli.
local.ask.why.reviewedLow: Sinuri ng AI ang hinihingi sa mensahe at walang nakitang malinaw na palatandaan ng panloloko. Hindi pa nakumpirma ang pagkakakilanlan ng nagpadala.
local.signalHelp.personalSafety: Kung ipinadala ito sa iyo, itabi ang mensahe at magsabi sa taong pinagkakatiwalaan mo. Kung may agarang panganib, humingi kaagad ng tulong.
local.signal.userinfo: Ang tunay na patutunguhan ay kasunod ng @ sa address.
local.signal.shortener: Itinatago ng pinaikling link ang huling patutunguhan nito.
local.signal.redirect: May address ng ibang site sa link na ito.
local.signal.new-number: May humihingi ng bayad gamit ang bagong numero.
local.signal.marketplace-payment-link: Dinadala ng mamimili ang pagbabayad sa link na nakatago ang patutunguhan.
local.signal.parcel-fee-link: Hinihingi ang bayad sa pakete sa isang di-pamilyar na website.
local.signal.task-income-recruitment: May alok na arawang kita sa simpleng gawain mula sa recruiter sa messaging app.
local.signal.phishing-test-link: Ito ang inilathalang phishing test page ng Google, na nakilala sa lokal na pagsusuri.
local.signalHelp.phishingTest: Kasama sa lokal na pagsusuri ang eksaktong test page na ito upang ipakita ang babala sa phishing. Walang ginawang live Safe Browsing check.
local.signal.delivery: May ipinagagawa ang nagpadala para raw maayos ang problema sa paghahatid.
local.signal.reward-action: May ipinagagawa ang alok para makuha ang premyo.
local.signal.reward-pressure: May maikling taning ang alok para makuha ang premyo.
local.signal.reward-information: Humihingi ng impormasyon ang alok para makuha ang premyo.
local.signal.download: Tumuturo ang link sa file na maaaring magpatakbo ng programa.
local.signal.account-bait: May pangakong pera at ibinigay na detalye sa pag-login ng iba.
local.result.tooLong: Hanggang 12,000 character ang bawat pagsusuri. Hatiin ang nilalaman at suriin bawat bahagi.
local.offline.title: Opsyonal na offline pack para sa teksto sa larawan
local.offline.body: Gumagana offline ang pagsusuri ng mensahe at link kahit wala ang pack. I-download ang 19.3 MB para mabasa ang teksto sa larawang Ingles at Filipino. Magsisimula lang kapag pinili mong mag-download o unang ginamit ang pagbasa ng larawan.
local.offline.download: I-download ang pack para sa teksto
local.offline.readyBody: Naka-save sa device ang pagbasa ng teksto sa larawang Ingles at Filipino. Kailangan pa rin ng internet ang online AI image check.
local.offline.savedBody: Naka-save na ang pack sa device na ito. Magagamit ang buong offline mode sa naka-install na Surfare app.
local.offline.unsupportedBody: Hindi makapag-save ng offline files ang browser dito. Buksan ang Surfare sa suportadong browser gamit ang ligtas na koneksiyon.
local.offline.storageError: Kulang ang storage para matapos. Magbakante ng espasyo, saka ituloy ang download.
local.offline.downloadError: Hindi natapos ang download. Suriin ang koneksiyon at subukang muli. Nananatili ang natapos na files.
local.offline.caching: Sinusave ang resources para sa offline use sa background
local.tour.offline.title: Magsuri kahit offline.
local.tour.offline.body: I-download dito ang resources para makapagsuri sa device kahit walang internet.
local.ask.welcome: May alinlangan? Magtanong tungkol sa mga babala o sa susunod na hakbang.
local.ask.noResult: Magsuri muna upang maipaliwanag ko ang mga babala at ang susunod na hakbang.
local.shortcuts.label: Mga shortcut
local.camera.reviewHelp: Nababasa ba ang maliliit na letra? Kumuha ulit kung malabo o mahirap basahin.
local.camera.tips: Gumamit ng sapat na liwanag, huwag igalaw, at ilagay ang text sa loob ng frame.
local.camera.quality.starting: Binubuksan ang camera. Ilagay ang text o QR code sa loob ng frame.
local.camera.quality.ready: Maayos ang detalye. Tiyaking malinaw ang maliliit na letra bago kumuha.
local.camera.quality.dark: Kulang sa liwanag. Lumipat sa mas maliwanag na lugar at iwasang matakpan ng anino ang text.
local.camera.quality.glare: Masyadong maliwanag o may silaw. Bahagyang ikiling ang camera o iwasan ang repleksyon ng ilaw.
local.camera.quality.moving: Huwag munang igalaw. Ipatong ang kamay o telepono sa matatag na ibabaw.
local.camera.quality.soft: Mukhang malabo ang larawan. Linisin ang lente, lumapit nang kaunti, at hintaying mag-focus ang camera.
local.camera.quality.detail: Ilapit at patagin ang text. Dapat mas mapuno ng maliliit na letra ang frame.
local.camera.quality.qrReady: May nakitang QR code. Suriin ang decoded text sa ibaba bago gamitin.
local.tour.invite.title: Gusto mo ba ng gabay?
local.tour.invite.body: Ituturo ni Surfy kung paano magsuri ng kahina-hinala. Maaari kang lumaktaw anumang oras o ulitin ang gabay mamaya.
local.intro.tagline: Mas ligtas mag-surf kapag sinusuring muli.
local.tour.label: Gabay sa Surfare
local.tour.welcome.title: Maligayang pagdating sa Surfare.
local.tour.settings.title: Piliin ang iyong wika.
local.tour.settings.body: Pumili rito ng English, Filipino, o Taglish. Gamitin ang wikang pinakaangkop sa iyo.
local.tour.detectors.title: Apat na paraan para magsuri.
local.tour.detectors.body: Pumili ng mensahe, link, larawan, o QR code. Walang susuriin hangga?t hindi mo pinipindot ang Suriin.
local.tour.input.title: Ilagay ang kahina-hinala.
local.tour.input.body: I-paste ang mensahe o link, o mag-upload ng larawan o QR code. Pindutin ang Suriin para magsimula.
local.tour.result.title: Malinaw na gabay kapag kailangan.
local.tour.result.body: Pagkatapos magsuri, makikita rito ang resulta, mga babala, at susunod na hakbang. Hindi garantiya ng kaligtasan ang resulta.
local.tour.practice.title: Magsanay kasama si Surfy.
local.tour.practice.body: Maglaro ng anim na maikling misyon tungkol sa mga scam sa Pilipinas. Piliin ang mas ligtas na hakbang at alamin kung bakit. Gumagana ang laro offline at dito sa device lang naka-save ang pinakamataas mong puntos.
local.tour.privacy.title: Sa iyo pa rin ang iyong nilalaman.
local.tour.privacy.body: Sa iyong device tumatakbo ang pagsusuri bilang default. Buksan ito para sa detalye. Pumindot kahit saan upang maglibot, o ulitin ang gabay sa footer.
local.nav.connectedBody: May koneksyon ka. Handa na ang local at online na pagsusuri.
local.nav.disconnectedBody: Maaari ka pa ring magsuri sa device na ito. Kailangan ng koneksyon ang ilang feature.
local.nav.localCapability: Suriin ang mga mensahe, link, naka-save na larawan, at QR code sa device. Dapat na-download na ang mga tool para sa larawan.
local.nav.onlineCapability: OpenRouter muna ang opsyonal na AI double-check, at Gemini ang backup.
local.nav.offlineLimit: Kailangan ng internet ang AI help at pagpapadala ng feedback.
local.hero.subtitle: Suriin ang mga kahina-hinalang mensahe, link, larawan, at QR code nang may malinaw na gabay sa bawat hakbang.

local.check.text.placeholder: I-paste ang mensaheng hindi ka sigurado...

local.check.link.privacy: Sa device sinusuri ang link. Ibinabahagi lang ang address kapag pinili mo ang AI help.

local.check.image.modeAiNote: Kapag pinili ito habang online, dadaan ang pinaliit na JPEG sa server ng Surfare papunta sa Sightengine. Hindi ina-upload ang orihinal na file o metadata nito. Mananatili ang lokal na resulta kapag pumalya ang online check. Maaaring mag-download ng humigit-kumulang 9.2 MB ang lokal na source-note tool sa unang gamit.
local.check.image.modeOcrNote: Sa device binabasa ang teksto. Maaaring i-download sa unang gamit ang 19.3 MB English at Filipino OCR pack. Ibinabahagi lang ang nabasang teksto kapag naka-on ang AI help.
local.check.image.modeOcr: Suriin ang text para sa scam
local.check.image.modeOcrHelp: Kunin ang text sa screenshot, mensahe o alok at suriin kung may mga babala ng scam.
local.check.image.modeAiHelp: Suriin muna ang creation notes sa device, saka gamitin ang Sightengine online para sa mga senyales ng AI.

local.result.description.low.body: Walang natagpuang palatandaan ng scam. Mag-ingat pa rin sa mga hindi inaasahang mensahe.
local.result.description.medium.title: Maalon
local.result.description.medium.body: May ilang babala. Huwag mag-click o magbayad hanggang makumpirma.
local.result.description.high.title: Malakas na Alon
local.result.description.high.body: Maraming palatandaan ng scam. Huwag makipag-ugnayan; i-block at i-report.

local.result.description.unknown.body: Kailangan pa ng konteksto. Idagdag ang buong mensahe o mas malinaw na larawan at hiwalay na kumpirmahin ang kahilingan.

local.result.summary.onlineOnly: Walang matinding babala sa text, pero ang web address na ito ay nasa listahan ng kilalang hindi ligtas na sites. I-check muna bago buksan.
