local.ask.clickedLink: Na-click ko na ang link. What now?
local.ask.clickedLink.answer:
Close the page at huwag nang mag-enter ng details.
- Kung nag-enter ka ng password or code, secure the account sa official app.
- Kung may na-download, update your security software at run a scan.
local.ask.sharedSecret: Na-share ko ang code or password. What now?
local.ask.sharedSecret.answer:
Secure your account sa official app or website now.
- Change the exposed password, pati sa ibang accounts kung reused ito.
- Contact official support kung nag-share ka ng code o may unfamiliar activity. Huwag i-send sa akin ang code.
local.ask.sentMoney: Nakapag-send na ako ng money. What now?
local.ask.sentMoney.answer:
Contact your bank or payment provider agad.
- Explain na suspected scam at ask kung puwedeng i-stop or reverse ang payment. Hindi guaranteed ang recovery.
- Keep the messages and receipts. Huwag magbayad sa promises na ire-recover ang money for a fee.
local.ask.verifySender: How do I verify ang sender?
local.ask.verifySender.answer:
Use a contact na ikaw mismo ang nahanap.
- Open the organization?s usual app or call a number na trusted mo na.
- Ask kung sila ang nag-send. Hindi proof ang name, logo, or profile photo lang.
local.ask.reportSender: Should I block or report ang sender?
local.ask.reportSender.answer:
If suspected scam, stop replying.
- Save the conversation kung need ng record, then use report or block sa app.
- Kung may money or account access involved, contact official support din.
local.ask.imageScreenshot: Does a screenshot affect the result?
local.ask.imageScreenshot.answer:
A screenshot may lose the original file notes.
- Missing notes do not prove na real or AI-made ang image.
- Online checks can add clues, pero hindi pa rin proof of authenticity.
local.ask.imageVerify: How do I find ang original image source?
local.ask.imageVerify.answer:
Find the original source bago mag-share.
- Ask for the original file or search for earlier copies.
- Compare the date and context. Hindi verified ang story dahil lang sa detector result.

local.recovery.label: Surfy Lifeguard
local.recovery.title: One step at a time, kasama mo ako.
local.recovery.launchBody: A little guidance kapag may parang hindi right.
local.recovery.resultAction: Na-click o nag-send na? Surfy Lifeguard can guide you
local.recovery.intro: May parang hindi right? Tell me what happened para mas malinaw ang puwedeng gawin.
local.recovery.planIntro: Follow the steps na fit sa situation mo. Ask Surfy kung may kailangan ka pang help.
local.recovery.multiple: Pick what fits. Okay lang kung hindi ka sure.
local.recovery.situation.shared: Nag-share ako ng password, PIN, OTP, or account details
local.recovery.situation.paid: Nag-send ako ng money or may unauthorized payment
local.recovery.situation.threatened: May nagte-threaten or blackmail sa akin
local.recovery.situation.danger: May taong in immediate physical danger
local.recovery.privacy: Sa device lang ang checklist mo. Ikaw ang pipili kung gagamit ng online AI help.
local.recovery.outside: For the Philippines ang numbers na ito, kaya hidden dito. For immediate danger, contact local emergency services. Use your provider's official app or website for account help.
local.recovery.contactIntro: Use official channels, hindi contacts mula sa suspicious message.
local.recovery.contact.emergency: For immediate danger to someone's physical safety in the Philippines. Do not wait to finish this checklist.
local.recovery.contact.gcash: 2882 is for Globe/TM subscribers. Urgent scam, fraud, and unauthorized-transaction support is available 24/7. Other networks can use the official Help Center's internet-call or chat options.
local.recovery.contact.maya: Maya app support: daily 8 AM to 7 PM, with after-hours assistance for emergencies such as suspected unauthorized transactions.
local.recovery.contact.bank: Contact the bank or provider sa official app, card, or trusted number. Doon muna i-report. BSP guidance covers escalation kung unresolved.
local.recovery.contact.cicc: For cybercrime at online-scam reporting sa Philippines. Kung may payment involved, bank or e-wallet muna. Hindi kapalit ng fraud support ang CICC.
local.recovery.step.safety.title: Put physical safety first
local.recovery.step.safety.body: Move to a safer place kung kaya at contact local emergency services. Reach a trusted person. Huwag hintayin ang Surfare or scam report for immediate danger.
local.recovery.step.payment.title: Report the payment to your provider now
local.recovery.step.payment.body: Ask kung puwedeng i-stop or dispute ang payment at secure ang account. Keep the reference number. Hindi guaranteed ang recovery; huwag magbayad sa stranger na promising to recover the money.
local.recovery.step.account.title: Secure the affected account
local.recovery.step.account.body: Use the official app or website sa trusted device. Change the exposed password, pati reused copies, at review active sessions. Contact support kung na-share ang OTP or PIN. Huwag i-send sa Surfare ang code.
local.recovery.step.device.title: Check your device
local.recovery.step.device.body: Do not open an unfamiliar download. Kung may installed app, update security software at run a scan. Avoid banking sa suspected compromised device; get trusted technical help if needed.
local.recovery.step.stop.title: Stop interacting with the suspicious page or sender
local.recovery.step.stop.body: Close the page. Huwag mag-enter ng more info, approve requests, or send more money. Opening a link alone does not confirm kung may exposed information.
local.recovery.step.review.title: Check what you actually did
local.recovery.step.review.body: Nag-type ka ba ng password, nag-approve ng code, nagbayad, or nag-install? Change your answers kung may maalala pa. Check account activity sa official app, hindi sa suspicious link.
local.recovery.step.evidence.title: Keep a private record
local.recovery.step.evidence.body: Keep messages, screenshots, receipts, at transaction references for official support. Huwag mag-share ng passwords or OTPs. Hindi included ang details na iyon sa downloaded plan.
local.recovery.step.threat.title: Get support for the threat
local.recovery.step.threat.body: Reach a trusted person at report through official cybercrime or police channels. Save the messages. For immediate physical danger, local emergency services agad.
local.recovery.step.report.title: Report through the relevant official channel
local.recovery.step.report.body: Use your provider's fraud process for account or payment issues at platform report tools for abusive accounts. Sa Philippines, CICC can receive cybercrime reports. Keep reference numbers.
local.recovery.limit: Guide ito sa options mo, one step at a time. Your provider can confirm kung ano ang possible.
local.recovery.rates: Availability can change. Philippine numbers ang short codes; charges may apply. Ikaw ang pipili kung tatawag or mag-o-open ng website.

local.qr.offline: Connect sa internet para ma-check ang link.
local.qr.privacy: Checking a short link contacts the website at follows HTTP redirects. Other links are contacted only kapag pinili mong i-check ang destination. Puwedeng ma-record ang visit. Walang QR image na ia-upload.

local.qr.limitation: Local rules at reference lists ang gamit sa bawat address. Hindi ito live reputation lookup o proof of safety. Hindi checked ang JavaScript, HTML refresh, browser-specific redirects, o page content. Hindi nagfo-follow ng links ang AI double-check.
local.qr.payload.text: May text ang QR na ito. Checked ito para sa warning signs.
local.qr.payload.private: May private details ang QR na ito. Sa device mo lang ang mga ito at hindi namin ma-verify dito.
local.qr.payload.unsupported: May action ang QR na hindi namin ma-check. Use it only kung trusted mo ang pinanggalingan.
local.qr.reason.blocked_target: Hindi kinontak ang target: blocked ang private networks, embedded credentials o access tokens, non-web protocols, at unusual ports.
local.qr.reason.redirect_loop: Naulit ang previous address. Stopped ang redirect check.
local.qr.reason.redirect_limit: Naabot ang redirect limit. Hindi ma-verify ang complete destination.
local.qr.reason.missing_location: Nag-return ang website ng redirect pero walang destination address.
local.qr.reason.invalid_redirect: Invalid ang redirect address na binalik ng website.
local.qr.reason.http_error: Website refused the request o nag-return ng error. Hindi ma-verify ang destination.
local.qr.reason.timeout: Hindi nag-finish responding ang destination sa takdang oras.
local.qr.reason.network: Hindi ma-reach ang destination. Applicable pa rin ang local warnings.
local.qr.reason.rate_limit: Maraming destination checks ngayon. Wait a moment at try again.
local.qr.reason.service_unavailable: Unavailable ang destination checking sa server na ito. Gumagana pa rin ang local QR checks.
local.qr.reason.invalid_request: Invalid ang QR destination request. Scan the code again.
local.qr.reason.origin: Hindi magamit ng page ang destination service. Refresh at try again.
local.qr.direct: Direct URL; walang HTTP redirect na nakita
local.qr.priorWarning: May warning signs sa earlier check; hindi ito cleared ng failed retry.
local.qr.simple.ready: May website link ang QR na ito
local.qr.simple.checked: Nakita namin kung saan papunta ang link
local.qr.simple.before: Check muna ang destination bago mag-decide kung io-open ito.
local.qr.simple.avoid: Huwag muna i-open. Use the usual app o website ng service instead.
local.qr.simple.confirm: Make sure ito ang website na expected mo. Hindi proof of safety ang pagkakita rito.
local.qr.simple.tryLater: Hindi namin ma-confirm kung saan papunta. Check with the sender bago i-open.
local.qr.simple.blocked: Huwag i-open unless trusted mo ang pinanggalingan.
local.qr.simple.sharing: Kokontakin nito ang linked websites. Puwede nilang i-record ang visit.
local.qr.simple.earlierWarning: Hindi namin ma-check ulit. Applicable pa rin ang earlier warnings.
local.qr.simple.checkedSummary: Nakita namin ang destination. Hindi nito proven na safe ang website.

local.destination.checking: Checking kung saan papunta ang link...
local.destination.checkingBody: Sinusundan namin ang short link at checked ang addresses along the way.
local.destination.beforeCheck: Checking follows short links online. Puwedeng ma-record ng website ang visit. Address lang ang sent sa link check, hindi ang buong message.

local.destination.linkBeforeCheck: Checking contacts this website at follows redirects. Puwedeng ma-record ang visit.

local.recovery.simple.title: One step muna.
local.recovery.simple.intro: Hindi mo kailangang harapin ito alone. Hanapin natin ang next step mo.
local.recovery.simple.doneIntro: Pwede mong balikan ang steps o save a copy.
local.recovery.simple.choice.shared: Baka at risk ang account o details ko
local.recovery.simple.trustedPerson: Kung overwhelming, ask someone you trust na samahan ka muna.
local.recovery.simple.foreignSupport: Open Help or Support sa usual app mo, o gamitin ang number sa card o trusted website.
local.recovery.simple.completedCount: {done} of {total} actions marked done. Nasa guide pa rin ang unfinished steps.
local.recovery.simple.local: No details needed para magsimula. Works offline ang guide.
local.recovery.simple.step.payment: Huwag nang mag-send ng pera. Open Help sa app na ginamit mo to pay. Report the payment at ask kung pwede itong ma-stop o ma-dispute. Keep the case reference. Hindi guaranteed ang recovery.
local.recovery.simple.step.account: Use the official app sa trusted device. Change any exposed password at contact support kung na-share mo ang PIN o OTP. Huwag ibigay sa Surfare ang passwords o codes mo.
local.recovery.simple.step.device: Huwag buksan ang download. Kung installed na, avoid banking muna sa device na iyon. Update and run its security scanner, o ask a trusted person for technical help.
local.recovery.simple.step.stop: Close the page at stop replying. Huwag mag-send ng more money o codes, at huwag magbayad sa nangangakong mare-recover ang pera mo.
local.recovery.simple.step.review: Nag-send ka ba ng money, nag-share ng password o code, o nag-install ng app? Kung may naalala ka, use “May iba pa bang nangyari?” below to update your guide.
local.recovery.simple.step.evidence: Keep the messages, screenshots at payment receipts for official support. Store them privately. Huwag mag-share ng passwords o OTPs.
local.recovery.simple.step.threat: Tell someone you trust at keep the messages. Report the threat sa official police or cybercrime channels. Kung may immediate physical danger, get emergency help now.
local.recovery.simple.step.report: For payments or accounts, start sa fraud support ng provider. Report the sender sa platform too. Sa Philippines, CICC accepts cybercrime reports. Keep the reference numbers.
local.recovery.simple.step.safety: Pumunta sa safer place kung kaya. Contact local emergency services at someone you trust ngayon. No need tapusin muna ang guide.

base.ask.fallback: Puwede kitang tulungan sa mabilis na tanong, gaya ng bakit 'to na-flag o kung ano ang next step.

base.ask.why.onlyOnline: Walang strong warning sign sa text, pero 'tong web address na 'to ay nasa list ng kilalang unsafe sites. Treat it as unsafe hanggang ma-check ito sa company mismo.
base.ask.why.cleanUrl: Walang na-report na online threat para sa web address na 'to. Hindi ibig sabihin na legitimate 'to, kaya i-confirm sa official app o website.
base.ask.why.cleanOffline: Walang strong warning signs na lumabas sa on-device checks ng Surfare. Walang completed online check dito, kaya hindi 'to proof. I-confirm ang unexpected request sa official app o website.
base.ask.why.flaggedNoSignals: Na-flag ito ng Surfare bilang {level}, pero matuturo ko lang ang warning signs na nasa checked text. I-check ang unexpected request sa company mismo.
base.ask.next.low: Wala namang lumabas, pero mag-ingat pa rin. Kung unexpected ang request, i-check sa official app ng company o tumawag sa kilalang number.
base.ask.next.suspicious: Huwag muna mag-click, magbayad, o mag-share. I-verify ang request sa official app ng company o sa taong trusted mo.
base.ask.next.high: Huwag mag-reply o magpadala ng pera at codes. I-block at i-report ang sender, tapos kontakin ang company gamit ang official app o number.
base.ask.next.unknown: Add the full message o complete link. Verify sa official app o trusted contact bago kumilos.
base.ask.next.aiImageClues: Ask kung saan galing ang image o paano ito ginawa. Check ang source bago magtiwala o mag-share.

base.notice.title: Privacy & terms
base.notice.description: Guide sa checks, choices at information mo. Read hanggang dulo para magpatuloy.

base.notice.policy.purpose.title: Your local checks
base.notice.policy.purpose.body: Surfare looks for warning signs sa messages, links, images at QR codes. Local checks, image text reading at QR decoding run on your device. Guide ang results sa next step mo; puwedeng may ma-miss o ma-misunderstand na details.
base.notice.policy.sharing.title: Link checks on your device
base.notice.policy.sharing.body: Local rules at reference lists ang gamit sa link checks. Kapag pinindot ang Check habang connected, recognized short links sa messages, web addresses, image text at QR codes are followed automatically through our server. Address lang ang sent sa linked sites at HTTP redirect destinations; puwede nilang i-record ang visit. Links detector follows the entered web address kapag pinindot ang Check. Separate button ang ibang QR destination checks. Walang buong message o QR image na sent sa linked sites. Hindi followed ang recognized private QR data at links na may credentials o access tokens. Walang URL reputation service. Separate choice ang AI help.
base.notice.policy.ai.title: Choosing online help
base.notice.policy.ai.body: Optional ang AI help at off sa simula. Turning it on lets checked text (including text from images o QR codes), result details, questions, language at up to eight recent chat messages pass through Surfare server. AI double-checks go to OpenRouter at selected model provider nito first, with Google Gemini as backup. Ask Surfy chat also uses OpenRouter first, with Google Gemini as backup. Separate choice ang online image detection: smaller JPEG goes to Sightengine, without the original file at metadata. Text lang ang natatanggap ni Surfy, hindi image bytes. May sariling storage at data-use policy ang bawat provider. Local replies si Surfy kapag AI help is off. Separate choice ang AI double-check sa guide: your question, service name, country, selected situations at up to six recent chat messages go through our server to OpenRouter at selected model provider nito, with Google Gemini as backup. Off ito sa simula; AI knowledge ang gamit, walang web browsing. Local guidance works without it.
base.notice.policy.retention.title: What stays on your device
base.notice.policy.retention.body: Walang saved history ng checks o chat ang Surfare. Nasa current page session ang mga ito at clear kapag nag-reload o nagsara ka. Language, privacy acknowledgment, offline app files at downloaded reports may stay on your device. Up to three shared items can wait locally until opened. Unopened items expire after 10 minutes at removed kapag in-access o sa later share. Feedback goes through EmailJS to the team, kasama ang fields na inilagay mo, page address at send time; applicable ang sarili nilang retention policies. Hindi automatically ginagamit sa training ang submissions at feedback.
base.notice.policy.security.title: A few simple precautions
base.notice.policy.security.body: Share only content na may permission kang gamitin. Leave out passwords, one-time codes at private access links. Surfare uses request checks at other safeguards para tumulong protektahan ang information, though walang app na makakapangako ng perfect security.
base.notice.policy.rights.title: Your privacy rights
base.notice.policy.rights.body: Retained ang rights mo under RA 10173, ang Data Privacy Act. Where applicable, kasama rito ang being informed, access, correction, objection, erasure o blocking, portability, damages at complaint sa National Privacy Commission, subject to law. Puwede mong i-review o i-clear ang acknowledgment anytime. Hindi nito inaalis ang info na sent na sa ibang service; contact that service tungkol sa records nila. Nasa official links below ang full explanation ng rights mo.
base.notice.policy.terms.title: Using Surfare
base.notice.policy.terms.body: Use Surfare sa content na allowed kang i-check. Guide ang results: a warning is not proof of wrongdoing, at low risk is not a guarantee. Confirm unexpected requests through a contact o app na kilala mo na. Puwedeng Not now at keep browsing; checks at tour will ask you to read this notice first.

base.signalHelp.account: Puwedeng makuha ng iba ang account mo kapag na-share ang details o access. Sa official app mag-check.

base.signalHelp.address: Puwedeng itago nito kung saan talaga papunta ang link. Check ang full address bago mag-open o mag-enter ng details.
base.signalHelp.weakAddress: Hindi ito sapat na proof ng scam. Kailangan ding tingnan ang request at ibang warning signs.
base.signalHelp.pattern: May similar na words o address sa reference data. Puwedeng mali ang match, kaya clue lang ito at hindi proof.

base.signal.winnings-deposit: May cash-in o deposit kapalit ng promised winnings.

base.result.sightengine.low: Walang clear na signs ng AI
base.result.sightengine.summary.high: May nakita kaming signs na maaaring gumamit ng AI. Puwedeng magkamali ang check na ito.
base.result.sightengine.summary.low: Wala kaming nakitang clear na signs ng AI. Hindi nito pinapatunayang real photo ito.
base.result.sightengine.summary.uncertain: Hindi masabi ng check kung gumamit ng AI. Makakatulong ang original image o source nito.

base.result.sightengine.limitation: Puwedeng magkamali ang automated detection. Screenshots, recompression at edits can change the result. Hindi nito proof kung paano ginawa ang image.

base.result.imageSimple.next: Check muna ang original source bago magtiwala o mag-share ng image.

base.ask.imageLimits.answer: Oo. Puwedeng ma-miss ng AI check ang AI images o mapagkamalang AI ang real photos. Screenshots at edits can change the result, kaya check ang original source kung mahalaga ito.
base.ask.imageScore.answer: From 0 to 1 ang score. Mas mataas ang number, mas maraming signs ng AI ang nakita ng checker. Hindi ito percentage ng accuracy ng check.
base.ask.imageScore.unavailable: Wala pang online score para sa image na ito. Try ang online image check kapag available na.

base.ask.clickedLink: Na-click ko na ang link. What now?
base.ask.clickedLink.answer:
Close the page at huwag nang mag-enter ng details.
- Kung nag-enter ka ng password or code, secure the account sa official app.
- Kung may na-download, update your security software at run a scan.
base.ask.sharedSecret: Na-share ko ang code or password. What now?
base.ask.sharedSecret.answer:
Secure your account sa official app or website now.
- Change the exposed password, pati sa ibang accounts kung reused ito.
- Contact official support kung nag-share ka ng code o may unfamiliar activity. Huwag i-send sa akin ang code.
base.ask.sentMoney: Nakapag-send na ako ng money. What now?
base.ask.sentMoney.answer:
Contact your bank or payment provider agad.
- Explain na suspected scam at ask kung puwedeng i-stop or reverse ang payment. Hindi guaranteed ang recovery.
- Keep the messages and receipts. Huwag magbayad sa promises na ire-recover ang money for a fee.
base.ask.verifySender: How do I verify ang sender?
base.ask.verifySender.answer:
Use a contact na ikaw mismo ang nahanap.
- Open the organization?s usual app or call a number na trusted mo na.
- Ask kung sila ang nag-send. Hindi proof ang name, logo, or profile photo lang.
base.ask.reportSender: Should I block or report ang sender?
base.ask.reportSender.answer:
If suspected scam, stop replying.
- Save the conversation kung need ng record, then use report or block sa app.
- Kung may money or account access involved, contact official support din.
base.ask.imageScreenshot: Does a screenshot affect the result?
base.ask.imageScreenshot.answer:
A screenshot may lose the original file notes.
- Missing notes do not prove na real or AI-made ang image.
- Online checks can add clues, pero hindi pa rin proof of authenticity.
base.ask.imageVerify: How do I find ang original image source?
base.ask.imageVerify.answer:
Find the original source bago mag-share.
- Ask for the original file or search for earlier copies.
- Compare the date and context. Hindi verified ang story dahil lang sa detector result.

base.recovery.contact.cicc: For cybercrime at online-scam reporting sa Philippines. Kung may payment involved, bank or e-wallet muna. Hindi kapalit ng fraud support ang CICC.
base.recovery.step.safety.title: Put physical safety first
base.recovery.step.safety.body: Move to a safer place kung kaya at contact local emergency services. Reach a trusted person. Huwag hintayin ang Surfare or scam report for immediate danger.
base.recovery.step.payment.title: Report the payment to your provider now
base.recovery.step.payment.body: Ask kung puwedeng i-stop or dispute ang payment at secure ang account. Keep the reference number. Hindi guaranteed ang recovery; huwag magbayad sa stranger na promising to recover the money.
base.recovery.step.account.title: Secure the affected account
base.recovery.step.account.body: Use the official app or website sa trusted device. Change the exposed password, pati reused copies, at review active sessions. Contact support kung na-share ang OTP or PIN. Huwag i-send sa Surfare ang code.
base.recovery.step.device.title: Check your device
base.recovery.step.device.body: Do not open an unfamiliar download. Kung may installed app, update security software at run a scan. Avoid banking sa suspected compromised device; get trusted technical help if needed.
base.recovery.step.stop.title: Stop interacting with the suspicious page or sender
base.recovery.step.stop.body: Close the page. Huwag mag-enter ng more info, approve requests, or send more money. Opening a link alone does not confirm kung may exposed information.
base.recovery.step.review.title: Check what you actually did
base.recovery.step.review.body: Nag-type ka ba ng password, nag-approve ng code, nagbayad, or nag-install? Change your answers kung may maalala pa. Check account activity sa official app, hindi sa suspicious link.
base.recovery.step.evidence.title: Keep a private record
base.recovery.step.evidence.body: Keep messages, screenshots, receipts, at transaction references for official support. Huwag mag-share ng passwords or OTPs. Hindi included ang details na iyon sa downloaded plan.
base.recovery.step.threat.title: Get support for the threat
base.recovery.step.threat.body: Reach a trusted person at report through official cybercrime or police channels. Save the messages. For immediate physical danger, local emergency services agad.
base.recovery.step.report.title: Report through the relevant official channel
base.recovery.step.report.body: Use your provider's fraud process for account or payment issues at platform report tools for abusive accounts. Sa Philippines, CICC can receive cybercrime reports. Keep reference numbers.
base.recovery.limit: Guide ito sa options mo, one step at a time. Your provider can confirm kung ano ang possible.
base.recovery.rates: Availability can change. Philippine numbers ang short codes; charges may apply. Ikaw ang pipili kung tatawag or mag-o-open ng website.
base.signal.gift-card-prize-fee: May prize offer na nagpapabili ng gift card o nagpapasend ng code nito.
base.signal.unsolicited-work-offer: May paid-work selection na dinadala ka sa unverified link.
base.signal.parcel-update-link: Hinihingi ang delivery details sa unfamiliar website.
base.signal.account-alert-link: May bank o wallet alert na dinadala ka sa labas ng listed official sites.
base.notice.singleAcknowledgment: Nabasa at naintindihan ko ang privacy notice at terms. Choice ko pa rin ang optional online help.
base.notice.scrollToContinue: Scroll hanggang dulo, then i-tick ang box sa ibaba.
base.notice.reachedEnd: Naabot mo na ang end. Puwede mo nang i-tick ang box.
base.ask.onlineProcessing: Optional online help para sa content na pinili mong i-check. Open ang info button para sa details.
base.ask.onlinePrivacy: About the AI double-check at privacy
base.ask.helpInfo.title: About the AI double-check
base.ask.helpInfo.what: The AI double-check adds a second look sa check mo at helps Surfy answer your questions. Kailangan ng internet at puwede pa ring may ma-miss na details.
base.ask.helpInfo.privacy: Kapag on, your checked text, result details, questions at recent chat go to online AI services. Walang saved check history ang Surfare; may sariling data policies ang services na iyon.
base.ask.helpInfo.choice: Puwede mong i-off anytime. Separate choice ang image checks.
base.ask.helpInfo.chatWhat: AI chat help lets Surfy explain ang image result mo at answer follow-up questions. Kailangan ng internet at hindi nito binabago ang image check.
base.ask.helpInfo.chatPrivacy: Written check details, questions at recent chat ang natatanggap ni Surfy, hindi ang photo mo. Walang saved check history ang Surfare; may sariling data policies ang online services.
base.recovery.providerHint: e.g. BPI, UnionBank, PayPal o Facebook
base.recovery.providerOptional: Service name lang. No account numbers, passwords o codes needed.
base.recovery.chat.title: Ask Surfy
base.recovery.chat.subtitle: Tulong sa kung ano ang next.
base.recovery.chat.offline: Offline ka. Available pa rin ang checklist at local tips.
base.recovery.chat.greeting: Tutulungan kitang figure out ang next step. Tell me what happened or pick a question below.
base.recovery.chat.unavailable: Unavailable ang online help ni Surfy. Here is a general next step:
base.recovery.chat.privacy: No passwords or codes needed. Chat clears kapag isinara ang Surfy Lifeguard. Online services have their own data policies.
base.recovery.chat.prompt.contact: How do I find the right support?
base.recovery.chat.clarify: Piliin ang nangyari sa checklist para may general next step. For more specific questions, add the service name at turn on the AI double-check.
base.recovery.chat.localContact: Start sa Help o Support ng usual app mo. For a bank card, use the contact printed on it. Add the service name at enable the AI double-check for more guidance.
base.recovery.chat.onlineInfo: Surfy can help tailor your next steps. AI knowledge ang gamit, without live web browsing.
base.recovery.chat.inviteBody: Ask a question in your own words.
base.result.imageMetadata.visualNetwork: Hindi ma-reach ang image service. Check your connection at try again. Available pa rin ang local file notes.
base.qr.title: Tungkol sa QR code na ito
base.qr.offline: Connect sa internet para ma-check ang link.
base.qr.privacy: Checking a short link contacts the website at follows HTTP redirects. Other links are contacted only kapag pinili mong i-check ang destination. Puwedeng ma-record ang visit. Walang QR image na ia-upload.
base.qr.summary: Check muna kung saan papunta ang link bago mag-open.
base.qr.warningSummary: May warning signs sa link. Huwag muna itong i-open.
base.qr.limitation: Local rules at reference lists ang gamit sa bawat address. Hindi ito live reputation lookup o proof of safety. Hindi checked ang JavaScript, HTML refresh, browser-specific redirects, o page content. Hindi nagfo-follow ng links ang AI double-check.
base.qr.payload.text: May text ang QR na ito. Checked ito para sa warning signs.
base.qr.payload.private: May private details ang QR na ito. Sa device mo lang ang mga ito at hindi namin ma-verify dito.
base.qr.payload.unsupported: May action ang QR na hindi namin ma-check. Use it only kung trusted mo ang pinanggalingan.
base.qr.reason.blocked_target: Hindi kinontak ang target: blocked ang private networks, embedded credentials o access tokens, non-web protocols, at unusual ports.
base.qr.reason.redirect_loop: Naulit ang previous address. Stopped ang redirect check.
base.qr.reason.redirect_limit: Naabot ang redirect limit. Hindi ma-verify ang complete destination.
base.qr.reason.missing_location: Nag-return ang website ng redirect pero walang destination address.
base.qr.reason.invalid_redirect: Invalid ang redirect address na binalik ng website.
base.qr.reason.http_error: Website refused the request o nag-return ng error. Hindi ma-verify ang destination.
base.qr.reason.timeout: Hindi nag-finish responding ang destination sa takdang oras.
base.qr.reason.network: Hindi ma-reach ang destination. Applicable pa rin ang local warnings.
base.qr.reason.rate_limit: Maraming destination checks ngayon. Wait a moment at try again.
base.qr.reason.service_unavailable: Unavailable ang destination checking sa server na ito. Gumagana pa rin ang local QR checks.
base.qr.reason.invalid_request: Invalid ang QR destination request. Scan the code again.
base.qr.reason.origin: Hindi magamit ng page ang destination service. Refresh at try again.
base.qr.direct: Direct URL; walang HTTP redirect na nakita
base.qr.priorWarning: May warning signs sa earlier check; hindi ito cleared ng failed retry.
base.qr.simple.ready: May website link ang QR na ito
base.qr.simple.checked: Nakita namin kung saan papunta ang link
base.qr.simple.before: Check muna ang destination bago mag-decide kung io-open ito.
base.qr.simple.avoid: Huwag muna i-open. Use the usual app o website ng service instead.
base.qr.simple.confirm: Make sure ito ang website na expected mo. Hindi proof of safety ang pagkakita rito.
base.qr.simple.tryLater: Hindi namin ma-confirm kung saan papunta. Check with the sender bago i-open.
base.qr.simple.blocked: Huwag i-open unless trusted mo ang pinanggalingan.
base.qr.simple.sharing: Kokontakin nito ang linked websites. Puwede nilang i-record ang visit.
base.qr.simple.earlierWarning: Hindi namin ma-check ulit. Applicable pa rin ang earlier warnings.
base.qr.simple.checkedSummary: Nakita namin ang destination. Hindi nito proven na safe ang website.
base.destination.title: Kung saan papunta ang link
base.destination.ready: Ito ang link na nakita namin
base.destination.privacy: Selected address lang ang ipinapadala ng destination check through Surfare to the linked websites. Puwede nilang i-record ang visit. Hindi kasama ang buong message.
base.destination.foundHost: Papunta ang link na ito sa {host}.
base.destination.checking: Checking kung saan papunta ang link...
base.destination.checkingBody: Sinusundan namin ang short link at checked ang addresses along the way.
base.destination.beforeCheck: Checking follows short links online. Puwedeng ma-record ng website ang visit. Address lang ang sent sa link check, hindi ang buong message.
base.qr.reason.hidden_destination: Hindi namin makita ang final website. Kailangan ng browser ang short link o walang redirect na binalik.
base.destination.linkBeforeCheck: Checking contacts this website at follows redirects. Puwedeng ma-record ang visit.
base.destination.addressChecked: Checked ang redirects; hindi ang page content.

incoming.result.loginQr.title: Login QR code
incoming.result.loginQr.summary: Mukhang device-linking code ito, hindi website address. Hindi sapat iyon para sabihing scam. Hindi ma-confirm ng Surfare kung sino ang gumawa nito. Nananatili ang code sa device mo.
incoming.result.loginQr.next: Gamitin lang sa official app para sa login na ikaw ang nagsimula sa sarili mong device.
incoming.check.progress.wait: Lalabas dito ang final result kapag tapos na ang review.
incoming.check.progress.local: Chine-check ni Surfy ang ipinadala mo.
incoming.result.backgroundReview: Ready na sa ibaba ang local result. Nagre-review pa ang AI at puwede itong magbago. Automatic na mag-u-update ang page.
incoming.check.progress.caution: May seryosong warning sa first check. Maghintay muna bago kumilos.
incoming.check.status.reading: Binabasa ni Surfy ang shared mo
incoming.check.status.link: Chine-check ni Surfy kung saan papunta ang link
incoming.check.status.detailReading: Binabasa ni Surfy ang text, link, o file na shared mo para tamang details ang gagamitin.
incoming.check.status.detailSignals: Naghahanap kami ng common scam signs gaya ng urgency, payment requests, at suspicious links.
incoming.check.status.detailLinks: Chine-check ang link sa safe na paraan para malaman kung saan papunta bago ma-final ang result.
incoming.check.status.detailDouble: Tapos na ang first check. Dino-double-check ni Surfy ang context at edge cases.
incoming.check.status.detailFinish: Automatic mag-u-update ang page pag ready na ang final result. Puwede ka maghintay dito.
incoming.check.status.hint: Karamihang check ay ilang seconds lang.
incoming.check.status.tip: Huwag mag-send ng pera o mag-share ng code habang nare-review pa.
incoming.check.status.linkNote: Sinusundan ang short link para lang i-check ang destination, hindi para mag-login.
incoming.check.highlightHint: I-tap ang highlighted words para malaman kung bakit.
incoming.check.nextSafety: I-save ang message at magsabi sa taong trusted mo. Kung may agarang panganib, humingi agad ng tulong.
incoming.result.noLocalWarning: Walang recognised scam o threat pattern na nakita sa local check. Hindi nito verified ang sender o guaranteed na safe ang message.
incoming.result.ocrUncertain: May mga salitang malabo. I-compare ang nabasang text sa image at ayusin ito bago mag-check ulit.
incoming.result.reviewText: I-edit ang nabasang text at i-check ulit
incoming.result.qrUnsupported: May naka-encode na data rito. I-check ang recipient o details sa app na nag-issue nito.
incoming.result.conflictingReviews: Iba ang basa ng AI. Nananatili ang mas mataas na warning dahil may ebidensiyang kailangang i-verify.
incoming.result.offlineNotice: Offline ka. Local checks lang ang resulta; available ang AI help kapag connected ka ulit.
incoming.ask.why.reviewedLow: Ni-review ng AI ang hinihingi sa message at wala itong nakitang malinaw na scam clue. Hindi pa verified ang sender.
incoming.signalHelp.personalSafety: Kung ipinadala ito sa iyo, i-save ang message at magsabi sa taong trusted mo. Kung nasa panganib ka ngayon, humingi agad ng tulong.
incoming.signal.userinfo: Nasa pagkatapos ng @ ang totoong destination.
incoming.signal.shortener: Nakatago ang final destination ng short link.
incoming.signal.redirect: May kasama itong address sa ibang site.
incoming.signal.new-number: May humihingi ng payment gamit ang bagong number.
incoming.signal.marketplace-payment-link: Dumadaan ang payment ng buyer sa link na nakatago ang destination.
incoming.signal.parcel-fee-link: May parcel fee na ipinapabayad sa unfamiliar payment website.
incoming.signal.task-income-recruitment: May hiring offer ng daily pay para sa simple tasks mula sa recruiter sa messaging app.
incoming.signal.phishing-test-link: Ito ang published phishing test page ng Google, na nakilala locally.
incoming.signalHelp.phishingTest: Kasama locally ang exact test page na ito para ipakita ang phishing warning. Walang live Safe Browsing check na ginawa.
incoming.signal.delivery: May pinapagawa ang sender para raw maayos ang delivery.
incoming.signal.reward-action: May pinapagawa ang offer para ma-claim ang prize.
incoming.signal.reward-pressure: May maikling deadline para ma-claim ang reward.
incoming.signal.reward-information: Humihingi ng details ang offer para ma-claim ang prize.
incoming.signal.download: Ang link ay papunta sa file na maaaring magpatakbo ng software.
incoming.signal.account-bait: May promise ng pera kasama ang login details ng ibang tao.
incoming.result.tooLong: Hanggang 12,000 characters bawat check. Hatiin ang content at i-check bawat bahagi.
incoming.offline.readyHelp: Ready nang gamitin nang walang internet ang local checks at saved image-text tools.
incoming.offline.installPhone: I-install ang Surfare para sa phone
incoming.tour.offline.title: Check kahit offline.
incoming.tour.offline.body: Local checks work sa device. Awtomatikong dina-download ang image-text tools kapag online ka.
incoming.ask.welcome: May duda? Ask about warning signs o kung ano ang next step.
incoming.ask.noResult: Run a check muna para ma-explain ko ang warning signs at next steps.
incoming.fallback.missing: Kailangan 'to ng mas malapit na tingin.
incoming.shortcuts.label: Quick shortcuts
incoming.camera.reviewHelp: Nababasa ba ang small text? Retake kung blurry o mahirap basahin.
incoming.camera.photoAlt: Photo na kinuha gamit ang camera
incoming.camera.tips: Use good lighting, hold steady, at keep the text sa loob ng frame.
incoming.camera.quality.starting: Starting ang camera. Keep the text o QR code sa loob ng frame.
incoming.camera.quality.ready: Mukhang okay ang detail. Check na sharp ang small text bago kumuha.
incoming.camera.quality.dark: Kulang sa light. Move sa brighter spot at iwasang matakpan ng shadow ang text.
incoming.camera.quality.glare: May glare o sobrang liwanag. Tilt nang kaunti ang camera o bawasan ang reflection.
incoming.camera.quality.moving: Hold steady muna. I-rest ang hands o phone sa stable na surface.
incoming.camera.quality.soft: Mukhang blurry. Clean the lens, move a little closer, at hintaying mag-focus ang camera.
incoming.camera.quality.detail: Ilapit at keep flat ang text. Small text should fill more of the frame.
incoming.camera.quality.qrReady: QR code found. I-check ang decoded text sa ibaba bago gamitin.
incoming.tour.invite.title: Quick tour muna?
incoming.tour.invite.body: Let Surfy show you paano mag-check ng suspicious. Puwedeng mag-skip anytime o replay the tour later.
incoming.intro.tagline: Safer surfing, kapag may second look.
incoming.tour.label: Surfare guided tour
incoming.tour.welcome.title: Welcome to Surfare.
incoming.tour.settings.title: Choose your language.
incoming.tour.settings.body: Switch between English, Filipino, or Taglish here. Piliin ang language na comfortable ka.
incoming.tour.detectors.title: Four ways to take a closer look.
incoming.tour.detectors.body: Choose a message, link, image, or QR code. Walang scan hangga?t hindi ka nag-Check.
incoming.tour.input.title: Bring what feels off.
incoming.tour.input.body: I-paste ang message o link, o upload ng image o QR code. Then press Check para masuri.
incoming.tour.result.title: Clarity, when you need it.
incoming.tour.result.body: After a check, dito ang result, warning signs, at practical next steps. Hindi guarantee of safety ang result.
incoming.tour.practice.title: Practice with Surfy.
incoming.tour.practice.body: Play six short missions tungkol sa Philippine scams. Choose the safer action at alamin kung bakit. Works offline ang game, at dito sa device lang naka-save ang best scores mo.
incoming.tour.privacy.title: Your content stays yours.
incoming.tour.privacy.body: Sa device mo ang checks by default. Open this section for details. Tap anything para mag-explore, o replay the tour sa footer.
incoming.nav.connectedBody: Connected ka. Ready na ang local at online checks.
incoming.nav.disconnectedBody: Puwede ka pa ring mag-check sa device na ito. Kailangan ng connection ang ibang features.
incoming.nav.localCapability: Local checks work sa device mo kahit walang internet. Awtomatikong dina-download ang image-text tools kapag online ka.
incoming.nav.onlineCapability: OpenRouter muna ang optional AI double-check, with Gemini as backup.
incoming.nav.offlineLimit: Kailangan ng internet ang AI help at pag-send ng feedback.

incoming.check.image.modeOcrNote: Sa device binabasa ang text. Awtomatikong dina-download ang English at Filipino OCR pack kapag online ka. Shared lang ang extracted text kapag naka-on ang AI help.

incoming.check.image.modeOcrHelp: Kunin ang text sa screenshots, messages o offers at i-check kung may scam warning signs.

incoming.result.summary.cleanUrl: Walang kilalang online threat na nakita para sa web address na 'to. I-confirm sa official app o website.
incoming.result.summary.onlineOnly: Walang strong warning sign sa text, pero 'tong web address na 'to ay nasa list ng kilalang unsafe sites. I-check muna bago i-open.

incoming.result.imageMetadata.note.compressed: May ilang file notes na hindi nabasa.
incoming.result.imageMetadata.note.malformed: May ilang file notes na hindi nabasa dahil incomplete ang file.
incoming.result.imageMetadata.note.limit: Huminto kami magbasa ng file para ligtas yung check.

incoming.result.imageMetadata.note.unsupported: Walang mababasang notes ang file type na 'to.
incoming.result.imageMetadata.visualUnavailable: Hindi natapos ang online check. Na-check pa rin ang file notes.
incoming.result.imageMetadata.visualNotConfigured: Hindi configured ang image AI sa server na ito. Available pa rin ang local file notes.
incoming.result.imageMetadata.visualBusy: Busy ang Visual AI ngayon. Gumana pa rin ang file notes.
incoming.result.imageMetadata.visualIncomplete: Walang clear na sagot ang Visual AI. Gumana pa rin ang file notes.
incoming.result.imageMetadata.visualProvider: Hindi na-complete ng image service ang request. Try the image check again. Available pa rin ang local file notes.
incoming.result.imageMetadata.visualTimeout: Masyadong matagal ang online check. Try ulit.
incoming.result.imageMetadata.visualBadOutput: Hindi clear ang sagot ng Visual AI. Gumana pa rin ang file notes.
incoming.result.imageMetadata.visualRequest: Hindi makastart ang Visual AI mula sa page na 'to. I-refresh at subukang muli.
incoming.result.imageMetadata.visualConsent: Piliin ang online image check para mas matingnan ang image.
incoming.result.imageMetadata.visualOffline: Offline ka. File notes lang ang na-check.
incoming.result.imageMetadata.visualImageIssue: Hindi ma-prepare ang image para sa visual review. Gumana pa rin ang file notes.
incoming.result.imageOrigin.title: AI visual review
incoming.result.imageOrigin.limitation: Clue lang 'to. Pwedeng malito sa screenshot, edit, at bagong AI tools. Ang walang clear clues ay hindi ibig sabihin na totoo ang image.
incoming.result.imageOrigin.noText: Walang nabasang message text sa mode na 'to. Lumipat sa text reading para i-check ang mga salita sa image.
incoming.result.imageOrigin.noObservations: Walang specific na visual clue na napansin.
incoming.result.explanation.sample: May demand ng money at request ng account details—pattern ito na puwedeng phishing o financial fraud, kaya i-verify muna independently.

incoming.ask.why.cleanOffline: Walang strong warning signs na lumabas sa on-device checks ng Surfare. Walang completed online check dito, kaya hindi 'to proof. I-confirm ang unexpected request sa official app o website.
incoming.ask.why.flaggedNoSignals: Na-flag ito ng Surfare bilang {level}, pero matuturo ko lang ang warning signs na nasa checked text. I-check ang unexpected request sa company mismo.

incoming.ask.next.suspicious: Huwag muna mag-click, magbayad, o mag-share. I-verify ang request sa official app ng company o sa taong trusted mo.

incoming.notice.title: Privacy & terms
incoming.notice.description: Guide sa checks, choices at information mo. Read hanggang dulo para magpatuloy.

incoming.notice.ready: Ready na. Choice mo pa rin ang online help.
incoming.notice.policy.purpose.title: Your local checks
incoming.notice.policy.purpose.body: Surfare looks for warning signs sa messages, links, images at QR codes. Local checks, image text reading at QR decoding run on your device. Guide ang results sa next step mo; puwedeng may ma-miss o ma-misunderstand na details.
incoming.notice.policy.sharing.title: Link checks on your device
incoming.notice.policy.sharing.body: Local rules at reference lists ang gamit sa link checks. Kapag pinindot ang Check habang connected, recognized short links sa messages, web addresses, image text at QR codes are followed automatically through our server. Address lang ang sent sa linked sites at HTTP redirect destinations; puwede nilang i-record ang visit. Links detector follows the entered web address kapag pinindot ang Check. Separate button ang ibang QR destination checks. Walang buong message o QR image na sent sa linked sites. Hindi followed ang recognized private QR data at links na may credentials o access tokens. Walang URL reputation service. Separate choice ang AI help.
incoming.notice.policy.ai.title: Choosing online help
incoming.notice.policy.ai.body: Optional ang AI help at off sa simula. Turning it on lets checked text (including text from images o QR codes), result details, questions, language at up to eight recent chat messages pass through Surfare server. AI double-checks go to OpenRouter at selected model provider nito first, with Google Gemini as backup. Ask Surfy chat also uses OpenRouter first, with Google Gemini as backup. Separate choice ang online image detection: smaller JPEG goes to Sightengine, without the original file at metadata. Text lang ang natatanggap ni Surfy, hindi image bytes. May sariling storage at data-use policy ang bawat provider. Local replies si Surfy kapag AI help is off. Separate choice ang AI double-check sa guide: your question, service name, country, selected situations at up to six recent chat messages go through our server to OpenRouter at selected model provider nito, with Google Gemini as backup. Off ito sa simula; AI knowledge ang gamit, walang web browsing. Local guidance works without it.
incoming.notice.policy.retention.title: What stays on your device
incoming.notice.policy.retention.body: Walang saved history ng checks o chat ang Surfare. Nasa current page session ang mga ito at clear kapag nag-reload o nagsara ka. Language, privacy acknowledgment, offline app files at downloaded reports may stay on your device. Up to three shared items can wait locally until opened. Unopened items expire after 10 minutes at removed kapag in-access o sa later share. Feedback goes through EmailJS to the team, kasama ang fields na inilagay mo, page address at send time; applicable ang sarili nilang retention policies. Hindi automatically ginagamit sa training ang submissions at feedback.
incoming.notice.policy.security.title: A few simple precautions
incoming.notice.policy.security.body: Share only content na may permission kang gamitin. Leave out passwords, one-time codes at private access links. Surfare uses request checks at other safeguards para tumulong protektahan ang information, though walang app na makakapangako ng perfect security.
incoming.notice.policy.rights.title: Your privacy rights
incoming.notice.policy.rights.body: Retained ang rights mo under RA 10173, ang Data Privacy Act. Where applicable, kasama rito ang being informed, access, correction, objection, erasure o blocking, portability, damages at complaint sa National Privacy Commission, subject to law. Puwede mong i-review o i-clear ang acknowledgment anytime. Hindi nito inaalis ang info na sent na sa ibang service; contact that service tungkol sa records nila. Nasa official links below ang full explanation ng rights mo.
incoming.notice.policy.terms.title: Using Surfare
incoming.notice.policy.terms.body: Use Surfare sa content na allowed kang i-check. Guide ang results: a warning is not proof of wrongdoing, at low risk is not a guarantee. Confirm unexpected requests through a contact o app na kilala mo na. Puwedeng Not now at keep browsing; checks at tour will ask you to read this notice first.

incoming.signalHelp.pressure: Kapag minamadali ka, baka hindi mo na ma-check ang request. Pause muna at i-verify sa ibang paraan.
incoming.signalHelp.codes: Kapag nakuha ng iba ang code mo, maaari silang mag-sign in o mag-approve ng payment. Huwag itong i-share.
incoming.signalHelp.account: Puwedeng makuha ng iba ang account mo kapag na-share ang details o access. Sa official app mag-check.
incoming.signalHelp.money: Puwedeng mawala ang pera mo kung magbabayad bago mag-check. I-verify kung sino ang humihingi at para saan ang bayad.
incoming.signalHelp.identity: Madaling kopyahin ang familiar na pangalan. I-confirm ang sender o buong web address sa official app o website.
incoming.signalHelp.secrecy: Kapag secret lang, baka hindi makita ng trusted person mo ang problema. Magtanong muna bago kumilos.
incoming.signalHelp.address: Puwedeng itago nito kung saan talaga papunta ang link. Check ang full address bago mag-open o mag-enter ng details.
incoming.signalHelp.weakAddress: Hindi ito sapat na proof ng scam. Kailangan ding tingnan ang request at ibang warning signs.
incoming.signalHelp.pattern: May similar na words o address sa reference data. Puwedeng mali ang match, kaya clue lang ito at hindi proof.
incoming.signalHelp.report: Based ito sa regulator list o notice. Check ang official notice at exact service o web address.
incoming.ask.signalNotFound: Wala sa tags ng result na ito ang warning na iyan. Maipapaliwanag ko ang highlighted parts, pero hindi ko dapat sabihing may nakita kung wala naman.
incoming.ask.uncertain.answer: Puwedeng may ma-miss na scam o ma-flag ang real message. Clues ang tags, hindi proof. I-confirm ang unexpected requests sa official app o number na trusted mo.

incoming.signal.load-transfer: May pinapadial na code na puwedeng mag-transfer ng load mo.
incoming.signal.guaranteed-winnings: Promise ng sender na ipapanalo ka ng pera.
incoming.signal.winnings-deposit: May cash-in o deposit kapalit ng promised winnings.

incoming.result.sightengine.title: Sightengine image detection
incoming.result.sightengine.low: Walang clear na signs ng AI
incoming.result.sightengine.summary.high: May nakita kaming signs na maaaring gumamit ng AI. Puwedeng magkamali ang check na ito.
incoming.result.sightengine.summary.low: Wala kaming nakitang clear na signs ng AI. Hindi nito pinapatunayang real photo ito.
incoming.result.sightengine.summary.uncertain: Hindi masabi ng check kung gumamit ng AI. Makakatulong ang original image o source nito.
incoming.result.sightengine.scoreHelp: Higher score means stronger AI-generation signal. Hindi ito accuracy percentage.
incoming.result.sightengine.limitation: Puwedeng magkamali ang automated detection. Screenshots, recompression at edits can change the result. Hindi nito proof kung paano ginawa ang image.

incoming.result.sightengine.credentials: Image service rejected access. Contact Surfare support. Available pa rin ang local file notes.

incoming.result.sightengine.unsupported: Hindi ma-check online ang image na ito. Try ang ibang image.
incoming.result.imageSimple.fileAi: May banggit din ng AI sa file notes. Tingnan kung paano namin chineck para sa details.
incoming.result.imageSimple.next: Check muna ang original source bago magtiwala o mag-share ng image.
incoming.ask.imageMeaning: Ano ang meaning ng result ko?
incoming.ask.imageLimits.answer: Oo. Puwedeng ma-miss ng AI check ang AI images o mapagkamalang AI ang real photos. Screenshots at edits can change the result, kaya check ang original source kung mahalaga ito.
incoming.ask.imageScore.answer: From 0 to 1 ang score. Mas mataas ang number, mas maraming signs ng AI ang nakita ng checker. Hindi ito percentage ng accuracy ng check.
incoming.ask.imageScore.unavailable: Wala pang online score para sa image na ito. Try ang online image check kapag available na.

incoming.share.error.expired: Wala na ang shared item na ito. Please share it again.
incoming.share.error.unavailable: Hindi mabuksan ang shinare mo. Try ulit, o i-paste o i-upload dito.
incoming.result.unknown.withSignals: May ilang warning signs, pero hindi sapat para mag-verdict. I-verify muna bago mag-act.
incoming.ask.brief.noSigns: No clear scam signs, pero hindi pa verified ang sender.
incoming.ask.brief.verify: Verify unexpected requests sa official app o known contact.
incoming.ask.brief.unclear: Kulang ang reliable information para makatiyak.
incoming.ask.brief.noEvidence: Walang specific warning details na available.
incoming.ask.clickedLink: Na-click ko na ang link. What now?
incoming.ask.clickedLink.answer:
Close the page at huwag nang mag-enter ng details.
- Kung nag-enter ka ng password or code, secure the account sa official app.
- Kung may na-download, update your security software at run a scan.
incoming.ask.sharedSecret: Na-share ko ang code or password. What now?
incoming.ask.sharedSecret.answer:
Secure your account sa official app or website now.
- Change the exposed password, pati sa ibang accounts kung reused ito.
- Contact official support kung nag-share ka ng code o may unfamiliar activity. Huwag i-send sa akin ang code.
incoming.ask.sentMoney: Nakapag-send na ako ng money. What now?
incoming.ask.sentMoney.answer:
Contact your bank or payment provider agad.
- Explain na suspected scam at ask kung puwedeng i-stop or reverse ang payment. Hindi guaranteed ang recovery.
- Keep the messages and receipts. Huwag magbayad sa promises na ire-recover ang money for a fee.
incoming.ask.verifySender: How do I verify ang sender?
incoming.ask.verifySender.answer:
Use a contact na ikaw mismo ang nahanap.
- Open the organization?s usual app or call a number na trusted mo na.
- Ask kung sila ang nag-send. Hindi proof ang name, logo, or profile photo lang.
incoming.ask.reportSender: Should I block or report ang sender?
incoming.ask.reportSender.answer:
If suspected scam, stop replying.
- Save the conversation kung need ng record, then use report or block sa app.
- Kung may money or account access involved, contact official support din.
incoming.ask.imageScreenshot: Does a screenshot affect the result?
incoming.ask.imageScreenshot.answer:
A screenshot may lose the original file notes.
- Missing notes do not prove na real or AI-made ang image.
- Online checks can add clues, pero hindi pa rin proof of authenticity.
incoming.ask.imageVerify: How do I find ang original image source?
incoming.ask.imageVerify.answer:
Find the original source bago mag-share.
- Ask for the original file or search for earlier copies.
- Compare the date and context. Hindi verified ang story dahil lang sa detector result.

incoming.recovery.label: Surfy Lifeguard
incoming.recovery.title: One step at a time, kasama mo ako.
incoming.recovery.launchBody: A little guidance kapag may parang hindi right.
incoming.recovery.resultAction: Na-click o nag-send na? Surfy Lifeguard can guide you
incoming.recovery.intro: May parang hindi right? Tell me what happened para mas malinaw ang puwedeng gawin.
incoming.recovery.planIntro: Follow the steps na fit sa situation mo. Ask Surfy kung may kailangan ka pang help.
incoming.recovery.multiple: Pick what fits. Okay lang kung hindi ka sure.
incoming.recovery.situation.shared: Nag-share ako ng password, PIN, OTP, or account details
incoming.recovery.situation.paid: Nag-send ako ng money or may unauthorized payment
incoming.recovery.situation.threatened: May nagte-threaten or blackmail sa akin
incoming.recovery.situation.danger: May taong in immediate physical danger
incoming.recovery.privacy: Sa device lang ang checklist mo. Ikaw ang pipili kung gagamit ng online AI help.
incoming.recovery.outside: For the Philippines ang numbers na ito, kaya hidden dito. For immediate danger, contact local emergency services. Use your provider's official app or website for account help.
incoming.recovery.contactIntro: Use official channels, hindi contacts mula sa suspicious message.
incoming.recovery.contact.emergency: For immediate danger to someone's physical safety in the Philippines. Do not wait to finish this checklist.
incoming.recovery.contact.gcash: 2882 is for Globe/TM subscribers. Urgent scam, fraud, and unauthorized-transaction support is available 24/7. Other networks can use the official Help Center's internet-call or chat options.
incoming.recovery.contact.maya: Maya app support: daily 8 AM to 7 PM, with after-hours assistance for emergencies such as suspected unauthorized transactions.
incoming.recovery.contact.bank: Contact the bank or provider sa official app, card, or trusted number. Doon muna i-report. BSP guidance covers escalation kung unresolved.
incoming.recovery.contact.cicc: For cybercrime at online-scam reporting sa Philippines. Kung may payment involved, bank or e-wallet muna. Hindi kapalit ng fraud support ang CICC.
incoming.recovery.step.safety.title: Put physical safety first
incoming.recovery.step.safety.body: Move to a safer place kung kaya at contact local emergency services. Reach a trusted person. Huwag hintayin ang Surfare or scam report for immediate danger.
incoming.recovery.step.payment.title: Report the payment to your provider now
incoming.recovery.step.payment.body: Ask kung puwedeng i-stop or dispute ang payment at secure ang account. Keep the reference number. Hindi guaranteed ang recovery; huwag magbayad sa stranger na promising to recover the money.
incoming.recovery.step.account.title: Secure the affected account
incoming.recovery.step.account.body: Use the official app or website sa trusted device. Change the exposed password, pati reused copies, at review active sessions. Contact support kung na-share ang OTP or PIN. Huwag i-send sa Surfare ang code.
incoming.recovery.step.device.title: Check your device
incoming.recovery.step.device.body: Do not open an unfamiliar download. Kung may installed app, update security software at run a scan. Avoid banking sa suspected compromised device; get trusted technical help if needed.
incoming.recovery.step.stop.title: Stop interacting with the suspicious page or sender
incoming.recovery.step.stop.body: Close the page. Huwag mag-enter ng more info, approve requests, or send more money. Opening a link alone does not confirm kung may exposed information.
incoming.recovery.step.review.title: Check what you actually did
incoming.recovery.step.review.body: Nag-type ka ba ng password, nag-approve ng code, nagbayad, or nag-install? Change your answers kung may maalala pa. Check account activity sa official app, hindi sa suspicious link.
incoming.recovery.step.evidence.title: Keep a private record
incoming.recovery.step.evidence.body: Keep messages, screenshots, receipts, at transaction references for official support. Huwag mag-share ng passwords or OTPs. Hindi included ang details na iyon sa downloaded plan.
incoming.recovery.step.threat.title: Get support for the threat
incoming.recovery.step.threat.body: Reach a trusted person at report through official cybercrime or police channels. Save the messages. For immediate physical danger, local emergency services agad.
incoming.recovery.step.report.title: Report through the relevant official channel
incoming.recovery.step.report.body: Use your provider's fraud process for account or payment issues at platform report tools for abusive accounts. Sa Philippines, CICC can receive cybercrime reports. Keep reference numbers.
incoming.recovery.limit: Guide ito sa options mo, one step at a time. Your provider can confirm kung ano ang possible.
incoming.recovery.rates: Availability can change. Philippine numbers ang short codes; charges may apply. Ikaw ang pipili kung tatawag or mag-o-open ng website.
incoming.signal.gift-card-prize-fee: May prize offer na nagpapabili ng gift card o nagpapasend ng code nito.
incoming.signal.unsolicited-work-offer: May paid-work selection na dinadala ka sa unverified link.
incoming.signal.parcel-update-link: Hinihingi ang delivery details sa unfamiliar website.
incoming.signal.account-alert-link: May bank o wallet alert na dinadala ka sa labas ng listed official sites.
incoming.notice.singleAcknowledgment: Nabasa at naintindihan ko ang privacy notice at terms. Choice ko pa rin ang optional online help.
incoming.notice.scrollToContinue: Scroll hanggang dulo, then i-tick ang box sa ibaba.
incoming.notice.reachedEnd: Naabot mo na ang end. Puwede mo nang i-tick ang box.
incoming.ask.onlineProcessing: Optional online help para sa content na pinili mong i-check. Open ang info button para sa details.
incoming.ask.onlinePrivacy: About the AI double-check at privacy
incoming.ask.helpInfo.title: About the AI double-check
incoming.ask.helpInfo.what: The AI double-check adds a second look sa check mo at helps Surfy answer your questions. Kailangan ng internet at puwede pa ring may ma-miss na details.
incoming.ask.helpInfo.privacy: Kapag on, your checked text, result details, questions at recent chat go to online AI services. Walang saved check history ang Surfare; may sariling data policies ang services na iyon.
incoming.ask.helpInfo.choice: Puwede mong i-off anytime. Separate choice ang image checks.
incoming.ask.helpInfo.chatWhat: AI chat help lets Surfy explain ang image result mo at answer follow-up questions. Kailangan ng internet at hindi nito binabago ang image check.
incoming.ask.helpInfo.chatPrivacy: Written check details, questions at recent chat ang natatanggap ni Surfy, hindi ang photo mo. Walang saved check history ang Surfare; may sariling data policies ang online services.
incoming.recovery.providerHint: e.g. BPI, UnionBank, PayPal o Facebook
incoming.recovery.providerOptional: Service name lang. No account numbers, passwords o codes needed.
incoming.recovery.chat.title: Ask Surfy
incoming.recovery.chat.subtitle: Tulong sa kung ano ang next.
incoming.recovery.chat.offline: Offline ka. Available pa rin ang checklist at local tips.
incoming.recovery.chat.greeting: Tutulungan kitang figure out ang next step. Tell me what happened or pick a question below.
incoming.recovery.chat.unavailable: Unavailable ang online help ni Surfy. Here is a general next step:
incoming.recovery.chat.privacy: No passwords or codes needed. Chat clears kapag isinara ang Surfy Lifeguard. Online services have their own data policies.
incoming.recovery.chat.prompt.contact: How do I find the right support?
incoming.recovery.chat.clarify: Piliin ang nangyari sa checklist para may general next step. For more specific questions, add the service name at turn on the AI double-check.
incoming.recovery.chat.localContact: Start sa Help o Support ng usual app mo. For a bank card, use the contact printed on it. Add the service name at enable the AI double-check for more guidance.
incoming.recovery.chat.onlineInfo: Surfy can help tailor your next steps. AI knowledge ang gamit, without live web browsing.
incoming.recovery.chat.inviteBody: Ask a question in your own words.
incoming.result.imageMetadata.visualNetwork: Hindi ma-reach ang image service. Check your connection at try again. Available pa rin ang local file notes.
incoming.qr.title: Tungkol sa QR code na ito
incoming.qr.offline: Connect sa internet para ma-check ang link.
incoming.qr.privacy: Checking a short link contacts the website at follows HTTP redirects. Other links are contacted only kapag pinili mong i-check ang destination. Puwedeng ma-record ang visit. Walang QR image na ia-upload.
incoming.qr.summary: Check muna kung saan papunta ang link bago mag-open.
incoming.qr.warningSummary: May warning signs sa link. Huwag muna itong i-open.
incoming.qr.limitation: Local rules at reference lists ang gamit sa bawat address. Hindi ito live reputation lookup o proof of safety. Hindi checked ang JavaScript, HTML refresh, browser-specific redirects, o page content. Hindi nagfo-follow ng links ang AI double-check.
incoming.qr.payload.text: May text ang QR na ito. Checked ito para sa warning signs.
incoming.qr.payload.private: May private details ang QR na ito. Sa device mo lang ang mga ito at hindi namin ma-verify dito.
incoming.qr.payload.unsupported: May action ang QR na hindi namin ma-check. Use it only kung trusted mo ang pinanggalingan.
incoming.qr.reason.blocked_target: Hindi kinontak ang target: blocked ang private networks, embedded credentials o access tokens, non-web protocols, at unusual ports.
incoming.qr.reason.redirect_loop: Naulit ang previous address. Stopped ang redirect check.
incoming.qr.reason.redirect_limit: Naabot ang redirect limit. Hindi ma-verify ang complete destination.
incoming.qr.reason.missing_location: Nag-return ang website ng redirect pero walang destination address.
incoming.qr.reason.invalid_redirect: Invalid ang redirect address na binalik ng website.
incoming.qr.reason.http_error: Website refused the request o nag-return ng error. Hindi ma-verify ang destination.
incoming.qr.reason.timeout: Hindi nag-finish responding ang destination sa takdang oras.
incoming.qr.reason.network: Hindi ma-reach ang destination. Applicable pa rin ang local warnings.
incoming.qr.reason.rate_limit: Maraming destination checks ngayon. Wait a moment at try again.
incoming.qr.reason.service_unavailable: Unavailable ang destination checking sa server na ito. Gumagana pa rin ang local QR checks.
incoming.qr.reason.invalid_request: Invalid ang QR destination request. Scan the code again.
incoming.qr.reason.origin: Hindi magamit ng page ang destination service. Refresh at try again.
incoming.qr.direct: Direct URL; walang HTTP redirect na nakita
incoming.qr.priorWarning: May warning signs sa earlier check; hindi ito cleared ng failed retry.
incoming.qr.simple.ready: May website link ang QR na ito
incoming.qr.simple.checked: Nakita namin kung saan papunta ang link
incoming.qr.simple.before: Check muna ang destination bago mag-decide kung io-open ito.
incoming.qr.simple.avoid: Huwag muna i-open. Use the usual app o website ng service instead.
incoming.qr.simple.confirm: Make sure ito ang website na expected mo. Hindi proof of safety ang pagkakita rito.
incoming.qr.simple.tryLater: Hindi namin ma-confirm kung saan papunta. Check with the sender bago i-open.
incoming.qr.simple.blocked: Huwag i-open unless trusted mo ang pinanggalingan.
incoming.qr.simple.sharing: Kokontakin nito ang linked websites. Puwede nilang i-record ang visit.
incoming.qr.simple.earlierWarning: Hindi namin ma-check ulit. Applicable pa rin ang earlier warnings.
incoming.qr.simple.checkedSummary: Nakita namin ang destination. Hindi nito proven na safe ang website.
incoming.destination.title: Kung saan papunta ang link
incoming.destination.ready: Ito ang link na nakita namin
incoming.destination.privacy: Selected address lang ang ipinapadala ng destination check through Surfare to the linked websites. Puwede nilang i-record ang visit. Hindi kasama ang buong message.
incoming.destination.foundHost: Papunta ang link na ito sa {host}.
incoming.destination.checking: Checking kung saan papunta ang link...
incoming.destination.checkingBody: Sinusundan namin ang short link at checked ang addresses along the way.
incoming.destination.beforeCheck: Checking follows short links online. Puwedeng ma-record ng website ang visit. Address lang ang sent sa link check, hindi ang buong message.
incoming.qr.reason.hidden_destination: Hindi namin makita ang final website. Kailangan ng browser ang short link o walang redirect na binalik.
incoming.destination.linkBeforeCheck: Checking contacts this website at follows redirects. Puwedeng ma-record ang visit.
incoming.destination.addressChecked: Checked ang redirects; hindi ang page content.
